caterpillar.name: Caterpillar
caterpillar.sector: Construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, electric power generation (diesel and gas generator sets, energy storage, microgrid controls), Cat Financial
caterpillar.assess: Caterpillar is the incumbent spec in Gulf data centres, giga-projects and Aramco sites, sold through Zahid Tractor (22 Saudi branches, dealer since 1950) and Al-Bahar (UAE, Kuwait). Altaaqa's 1 GW Cat rental fleet absorbs outage-driven demand before any sale is tendered. Cat's large-engine capacity is being consumed by US AI builds through 2027, so delivery slots in the Gulf are the field where Cummins Arabia can move.

partners.label: Zahid Tractor & Heavy Machinery Co. Ltd. (Zahid Group)
partners.note: Sole Cat dealer for Saudi Arabia covering machines, engines, electric power, marine, oil and gas and Cat mining; 22 to 24 branches; engine rebuild centres Jeddah and Dammam; embedded site technicians on strategic projects
partners.insight: Seventy-five years of relationships with Aramco, SEC, giga-project developers and contractors give Cat first call on Saudi power tenders. Cummins Arabia competes against a dealer with more service points than it has; the counter is faster quotes, guaranteed lead times and total cost of ownership at the node level.
partners.mean: Threat: Seventy-five years of relationships with Aramco, SEC, giga-project developers and contractors give Cat first call on Saudi power tenders. Cummins Arabia competes against a dealer with more service points than it has; the counter is faster quotes, guaranteed lead times and total cost of ownership at the node level.

partners.label: Mohamed Abdulrahman Al-Bahar L.L.C.
partners.note: Cat dealer for UAE, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain (Oman via associate Oasis Trading); power systems sales, packaging, rental power with nine regional depots, CVAs, switchgear, UPS, ATS and load banks
partners.insight: Al-Bahar is the direct competitor to Cummins Arabia in UAE and Kuwait for every hospital, metro, oil and gas and data centre standby package. Its rental fleet lets it seed accounts with temporary power and convert to permanent Cat sets, a motion Cummins Arabia should match with its own rental partners.
partners.mean: Threat: Al-Bahar is the direct competitor to Cummins Arabia in UAE and Kuwait for every hospital, metro, oil and gas and data centre standby package. Its rental fleet lets it seed accounts with temporary power and convert to permanent Cat sets, a motion Cummins Arabia should match with its own rental partners.

partners.label: Altaaqa Alternative Solutions (Zahid Group)
partners.note: Largest single owner of Cat rental generators in the world, over 1 GW, 62 kVA to 2,000 kVA, six depots plus 17 Zahid branches, turnkey rental power plants for oil and gas, mining, cities and remote sites
partners.insight: Every MW Altaaqa deploys is a Cat MW and often becomes a permanent Cat sale. Cummins Arabia should target the rental buyers who want a second OEM for fleet resilience and price competition, and should protect its own rental partner relationships in KSA.
partners.mean: Threat: Every MW Altaaqa deploys is a Cat MW and often becomes a permanent Cat sale. Cummins Arabia should target the rental buyers who want a second OEM for fleet resilience and price competition, and should protect its own rental partner relationships in KSA.

partners.label: Altaaqa Global (Zahid Group) and Caterpillar
partners.note: Caterpillar International Power Projects partner for 20 to 100+ MW temporary power plants across Africa, Middle East, Latin America and Asia, Dubai based
partners.insight: Gives Cat a utility-scale temporary power channel that Cummins Arabia does not have in the Gulf. Relevant when Kuwait MEW or Saudi utilities seek bridging power; Cummins Arabia should partner with an IPP-style rental operator for those tenders.
partners.mean: Watch: Gives Cat a utility-scale temporary power channel that Cummins Arabia does not have in the Gulf. Relevant when Kuwait MEW or Saudi utilities seek bridging power; Cummins Arabia should partner with an IPP-style rental operator for those tenders.

partners.label: EJAR Cat Rental Store (Zahid Group)
partners.note: Cat Rental Store franchise in Saudi Arabia with mobile generator sets among rental lines; locations include Makkah and Dammam; part of Zahid's 2026 Sales Campus organisation
partners.insight: Small and mid-size rental gensets feed contractor relationships that later specify permanent standby sets. Cummins Arabia should ensure its C-series and QSK rental units are positioned with Saudi contractors through its own rental channel.
partners.mean: Watch: Small and mid-size rental gensets feed contractor relationships that later specify permanent standby sets. Cummins Arabia should ensure its C-series and QSK rental units are positioned with Saudi contractors through its own rental channel.

partners.label: Red Sea Global (The Red Sea Project)
partners.note: 69 Cat gensets, 32 MW prime power, B100 biodiesel capable, Cat Connect remote monitoring and CVAs supplied by Zahid Tractor for construction phase power
partners.insight: Cat holds the incumbent position on the Red Sea giga-project and its renewable fuel narrative. For permanent power phases (hotels, airport), Cummins Arabia should bid with HVO-compatible sets and hybrid microgrid options before the incumbent locks the follow-on.
partners.mean: Watch: Cat holds the incumbent position on the Red Sea giga-project and its renewable fuel narrative. For permanent power phases (hotels, airport), Cummins Arabia should bid with HVO-compatible sets and hybrid microgrid options before the incumbent locks the follow-on.

partners.label: NEOM (via Zahid Tractor)
partners.note: About 5,000 Cat machines on site with CVAs, technician training and 24/7 support through Zahid Tractor; power generation scope not stated
partners.insight: Zahid's machine footprint at NEOM gives it daily access to NEOM procurement. Cummins Arabia should not assume genset packages at NEOM are open competitions; it needs early engagement with NEOM's energy and data centre teams.
partners.mean: Watch: Zahid's machine footprint at NEOM gives it daily access to NEOM procurement. Cummins Arabia should not assume genset packages at NEOM are open competitions; it needs early engagement with NEOM's energy and data centre teams.

partners.label: Themar Al Emarat LLC
partners.note: 6 MW hybrid microgrid in Sharjah: 2.7 MW Cat PV, five Cat 3412 gensets (3.24 MW), Cat ESS 286 kWh/250 kW, Cat Master Microgrid Controller; 2020 follow-on with 3516E 50 Hz and 60 Hz HV ratings
partners.insight: Al-Bahar has a live UAE reference for single-supplier solar, genset and storage integration. Cummins Arabia should have a comparable hybrid reference in UAE or KSA to avoid losing agri, industrial and remote-site microgrid tenders on integration credibility.
partners.mean: Watch: Al-Bahar has a live UAE reference for single-supplier solar, genset and storage integration. Cummins Arabia should have a comparable hybrid reference in UAE or KSA to avoid losing agri, industrial and remote-site microgrid tenders on integration credibility.

partners.label: Lamprell
partners.note: Five Cat 3516C (1530 ekW, 60 Hz, 600 V) and one 3512C (1310 ekW) for the first of two LeTourneau Super 116E jack-up rigs, commissioned by Al-Bahar 2022-11
partners.insight: Cat owns the UAE offshore rig power niche through Al-Bahar. Cummins Arabia's marine and drilling engines could target the second rig and future ADNOC Drilling newbuilds if it can show class approvals and local commissioning capacity.
partners.mean: Watch: Cat owns the UAE offshore rig power niche through Al-Bahar. Cummins Arabia's marine and drilling engines could target the second rig and future ADNOC Drilling newbuilds if it can show class approvals and local commissioning capacity.

partners.label: Dubai Roads and Transport Authority (Dubai Metro)
partners.note: 20 Cat gensets (8 x 3516, 8 x 3512, 2 x C18, 2 x C15, 50 Hz, 320 to 1,820 kW) for emergency backup, with installation, training and three-year maintenance contract via Al-Bahar
partners.insight: The Dubai Metro fleet is now 15 years old and approaching replacement or major overhaul cycles. Cummins Arabia should position for RTA replacement and Route 2020 extension standby packages where an incumbent-only assumption may be weak.
partners.mean: Opportunity: The Dubai Metro fleet is now 15 years old and approaching replacement or major overhaul cycles. Cummins Arabia should position for RTA replacement and Route 2020 extension standby packages where an incumbent-only assumption may be weak.

partners.label: American Intelligence & Power Corp and Boyd CAT
partners.note: 2 GW of G3516 fast-response gas gensets plus BESS and SCR for the Monarch Compute Campus, 8 GW planned, deliveries 2026-09 to 2027-08
partners.insight: Establishes Cat gas gensets as prime power for AI campuses at multi-GW scale. Gulf hyperscale developers will benchmark against this. Cummins Arabia needs a documented gas prime power reference and a partner BESS to stay on shortlists.
partners.mean: Watch: Establishes Cat gas gensets as prime power for AI campuses at multi-GW scale. Gulf hyperscale developers will benchmark against this. Cummins Arabia needs a documented gas prime power reference and a partner BESS to stay on shortlists.

partners.label: Joule Capital Partners and Wheeler Machinery
partners.note: 4 GW data centre campus power in Utah on G3520K gensets with CCHP and 1.1 GWh grid-forming BESS, launch targeted 2026
partners.insight: Confirms the G3520K as Cat's flagship data centre prime power node. Cummins Arabia should prepare a node-by-node comparison of HSK78G against G3520K on efficiency, start time and footprint for Gulf ambient conditions.
partners.mean: Watch: Confirms the G3520K as Cat's flagship data centre prime power node. Cummins Arabia should prepare a node-by-node comparison of HSK78G against G3520K on efficiency, start time and footprint for Gulf ambient conditions.

partners.label: ProPetro (PROPWR)
partners.note: Framework for at least 1.5 GW, option to about 2.1 GW, of Cat gas generation assets over five years for data centres, oil and gas and industry
partners.insight: Shows Cat's willingness to sign multi-year volume frameworks with power-as-a-service operators. Gulf oilfield service and rental operators are the analogue; Cummins Arabia should offer framework pricing and priority allocation to lock them first.
partners.mean: Watch: Shows Cat's willingness to sign multi-year volume frameworks with power-as-a-service operators. Gulf oilfield service and rental operators are the analogue; Cummins Arabia should offer framework pricing and priority allocation to lock them first.

partners.label: OnePWR Solutions and Vero3
partners.note: Gas generation plus carbon capture, BESS and permanent CO2 sequestration for data centres; inaugural 500 MW prime power project launching 2026
partners.insight: Gas with capture is a credible answer to Gulf sustainability procurement criteria. Cummins Arabia should decide on a capture or offset partner or risk being screened out on carbon in NEOM and UAE net-zero aligned campuses.
partners.mean: Watch: Gas with capture is a credible answer to Gulf sustainability procurement criteria. Cummins Arabia should decide on a capture or offset partner or risk being screened out on carbon in NEOM and UAE net-zero aligned campuses.

caterpillar.company_size: Approximately 118,000 full-time employees as of 2025-12-31 (51,600 US, 66,400 outside US), per FY2025 Form 10-K
caterpillar.strategic_positioning: Caterpillar is the incumbent premium power generation brand in the Gulf, selling through two long-standing exclusive dealers: Zahid Tractor in Saudi Arabia (Cat dealer since 1950, 22 to 24 branches) and Mohamed Abdulrahman Al-Bahar in the UAE, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain (headquartered in Sharjah, Oman covered through associate Oasis Trading). Its Gulf reach is reinforced by the Zahid Group rental arm Altaaqa, the largest single owner of Cat rental generators in the world at over 1 GW, and by Caterpillar's own Middle East Distribution Center, district office and Learning Center in Jebel Ali. Globally, Cat is converting the AI data centre boom into record backlog and is tripling large reciprocating engine capacity to about three times 2024 levels by 2030, which means the 3516E, C175 and G3520K nodes that compete head on with Cummins in the 1.5 to 4 MW band will be more available and more aggressively marketed in the region from 2027

rolls-royce-mtu.name: Rolls-Royce mtu
rolls-royce-mtu.sector: Large diesel and gas engines, diesel and gas generator sets 40 kW to 4,000 kVA, dynamic UPS (Kinetic PowerPack), battery energy storage (EnergyPack), marine, rail and defence propulsion
rolls-royce-mtu.assess: mtu has changed its Saudi channel: Makeen, the Aramco, HD Hyundai and Dussur JV, became exclusive stationary power distributor from 1 October 2025 with a Ras Al Khair manufacturing licence, which gives mtu a Saudi content story Cummins Arabia does not yet have. In Kuwait, Al Mulla Power Solutions holds the franchise and the Airport T2 reference (7 x 20V4000 DS3600 rated at 55 C). Series 4000 output is committed for 2026, so mtu competes on spec and Saudisation, not on delivery.

rolls-royce-mtu.company_size: More than 10,350 worldwide at end of 2025; around 700 hires in 2025 and over 1,000 positions to be filled in 2026 (Rolls-Royce Power Systems results release, 2026-02-27)
rolls-royce-mtu.strategic_positioning: Rolls-Royce Power Systems is the premium German engine OEM behind the mtu brand and one of the three largest suppliers of emergency power to data centres worldwide, with power generation revenue up 30% in 2025 and 41% in H1 2026 on data centre demand. Its Gulf go-to-market runs through Rolls-Royce Solutions Middle East FZE in Jebel Ali (set up as MTU Middle East in 2015) plus three distributors: Al Masaood Power Division in the UAE and Bahrain (mtu since 1978, exclusive UAE distributor since 1982), Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (Makeen), an Aramco, HD Hyundai and Dussur JV that became exclusive stationary power distributor for Saudi Arabia on 2025-10-01, and Al Mulla Power Solutions in Kuwait (sole distributor since 2024-12-22). The KSA and Kuwait channels are young: Makeen's stationary power mandate is one year old and Kuwait's mtu MRO centre in Ahmadi completes only in September 2026, while the UAE channel is mature and already wins airport and data centre work. Product range against Cummins Arabia is concentrated in the 1,600 to 4,000 kVA Series 4000 band plus the gas 20V4000 and the Kinetic PowerPack, with global genset capacity doubling in the US in 2026 and a new Series 4000 assembly plant in Friedrichshafen from 2028

rehlko.strategic_positioning: Rehlko is the former Kohler Energy business, majority owned by Platinum Equity since May 2024 and rebranded in September 2024, with Kohler Co. retained as an investment partner. Its large genset play is the in-house KD Series (Liebherr-built engines, 800 kW to 4,500 kVA at 50 Hz and up to 4,000 kW at 60 Hz) built at Brest, France and Changzhou, China, and positioned hard at hyperscale data centres. In KSA, UAE and Kuwait it sells through Midis Group affiliates (MMR in Riyadh, Site & Power and Mideast Data Systems in the UAE, Site and Power Kuwait) plus Abunayyan Trading in Riyadh, supported by an SDMO Industries Middle East office and warehouse in Dubai. Clarke Energy, its gas engine arm, has no Gulf office as of September 2026

partners.insight: SDEC is an established Saudi packager with an Eastern Province factory and nationwide offices, so MGS in KSA comes with a credible local assembly and service story. Cummins Arabia should watch SDEC in Aramco and industrial 60 Hz tenders and use its own Saudi branch coverage and parts stock to compete.

perkins-fgwilson.strategic_positioning: Perkins sells engines to independent genset packagers and FG Wilson sells complete gensets, so the two Caterpillar brands reach Gulf buyers through channels that are separate from the Cat dealer network. In KSA and UAE the Perkins channel runs through Kanoo Machinery and its Dubai arm Power Systems Gulf, while the FG Wilson channel runs through Zahid Group's TAMGO in Saudi Arabia and the TAMGO-owned FG Wilson (Engineering) FZE in Jebel Ali. Perkins engines also enter the market inside Jubaili Bros, Teksan, Almajd Power and Generac packaged sets, which multiplies the brand's presence in the 500 to 2,500 kVA band where Cummins Arabia competes. The current product push is the electronic 5000 Series (5006 to 5016, 750 to 2,500 kVA) aimed at data centres and hospitals, plus HVO and B100 fuel flexibility

generac.strategic_positioning: Generac is a US residential and C&I generator maker that pivoted hard into data centres in 2025 to 2026: its SDMD1750 to SDMD3250 diesel sets (Baudouin Baudouin M55 and Baudouin M55 engines, Marathon DataMAX alternators, DSE G8601 controls, 50 degree C cooling) won a global supply agreement with a hyperscale operator covering the Middle East, and its data centre backlog reached about US$1.6 billion by July 2026. In the Gulf it operates through Pramac's PR Middle East FZE in Jebel Ali and through dealers listed on its international locator: Atlas Power Solutions (Dubai and Riyadh), Watan Altaqa for Equipment (Riyadh) and Al Mulla Power Solutions (Kuwait). Mid-range diesel sets (SD1000, SD1250) use Perkins 4008 and 4012 engines, and its own spark-ignited gas engines power the SG/MG range to 1,000 kW

volvo-penta.strategic_positioning: Volvo Penta sells engines, not gensets, so it competes with Cummins Arabia through independent Gulf packagers that pick a Volvo D13, D16 or D17 for the 400 to 833 kVA band. Its message is automotive-scale production, short lead times, HVO100 compatibility on every engine built since 2016, and a modular data centre approach; it does not have an engine above about 880 kVA, so it is absent from the large data centre and utility band. The 2023 D17 (TWD1744GE, 758 kVA prime at 50 Hz) and the 2026 G17 natural gas engine are its current power generation pushes. In Saudi Arabia, Almajd Power lists Volvo among the engines it packages; no other Gulf packager or Volvo Penta dealer for KSA, UAE or Kuwait could be verified from official sources

cummins.name: Cummins Arabia
cummins.sector: Distribution, sales and service of Cummins diesel and gas generator sets (2.5 kW to 3500 kW), engines, filtration, parts, BESS and HHP rebuild in Saudi Arabia, UAE and Kuwait
cummins.assess: Cummins Arabia is the exclusive Cummins distribution and service JV for Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait, formed in 2017 by Cummins Inc. and Olayan, whose Cummins distribution history in Saudi Arabia dates to 1956. It runs 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a service training centre with 550 plus staff. Its competitive position in Gulf power generation rests on the Cummins HHP range (QSK60, QSK78, QSK95 and the new Centum Series) for 60 Hz Saudi and 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait data centres, the PowerCommand controls and DMC paralleling family, and the 2025 addition of factory BESS. The 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale delivery and the first EMEIA BESS commissioning in Dubai are its current reference points

cummins.company_size: Over 550 professionals (Cummins press release, April 2025); close to 500 employees of 30 plus nationalities at launch (June 2017)
cummins.strategic_positioning: Cummins Arabia is the exclusive Cummins distribution and service JV for Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait, formed in 2017 by Cummins Inc. and Olayan, whose Cummins distribution history in Saudi Arabia dates to 1956. It runs 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a service training centre with 550 plus staff. Its competitive position in Gulf power generation rests on the Cummins HHP range (QSK60, QSK78, QSK95 and the new Centum Series) for 60 Hz Saudi and 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait data centres, the PowerCommand controls and DMC paralleling family, and the 2025 addition of factory BESS. The 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale delivery and the first EMEIA BESS commissioning in Dubai are its current reference points

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko launches programme to double Changzhou backup power capacity from 5.5 GW to 11 GW
competitiveCards.sowhat: Changzhou explicitly serves EMEA, so Gulf distributors can now source KD Series up to 4,000 kW from a plant with 11 GW annual capacity. This is a direct supply and price lever against Cummins Arabia in KSA, UAE and Kuwait data centre and industrial tenders. Cummins Arabia should benchmark Changzhou-sourced pricing on 1.5 MW to 3 MW sets and reinforce total cost of ownership and local service arguments.
competitiveCards.summary: Changzhou builds generator systems from 6 kW to 4,000 kW and key components, serving China, Southeast Asia, EMEA and Latin America; CEO called it a critical hub for EMEA. The 11 GW target is to be reached without expanding the footprint; first pass yield up from 93% to 98%.

competitiveCards.title: FG Wilson Catalyst 2026: 60th anniversary global dealer conference in Belfast
competitiveCards.sowhat: A dealer conference of this scale signals a channel re-energising exercise. Expect dealer targets and campaign activity in the Gulf over the next 12 months, especially from FG Wilson (Engineering) FZE and TAMGO. Cummins Arabia should expect sharper FG Wilson pricing in the 500 to 1,500 kVA commercial band.
competitiveCards.summary: FG Wilson gathered its global dealer network, customers and staff in Belfast's Titanic Quarter for a week of strategy, innovation and growth sessions and a Product Discovery Zone. No new product launches were announced.

competitiveCards.title: Weichai H1 2026: data centre genset sales above 1,400 units, more than all of 2025
competitiveCards.sowhat: Run-rate of roughly 2,800 data centre gensets a year puts Weichai among the largest volume producers of data centre sets worldwide. Gulf hyperscalers that buy globally will see Weichai and Baudouin on approved vendor lists, which erodes the reference advantage Cummins holds in the region.
competitiveCards.summary: Weichai reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB 123.16 billion (up 8.8 percent) and net profit of RMB 7.7 billion (up 36.5 percent). Data centre generator sales exceeded 1,400 units in the half, surpassing full-year 2025, with M-series high-power engines at 6,700 units (up 31.5 percent). Baudouin signed a strategic cooperation with a major French customer.

competitiveCards.title: Yuchai (China Yuchai International, Singapore HQ, NYSE CYD) is the second Chinese engine OEM whose genset engines appear in low-cost Gulf packages
competitiveCards.sowhat: Yuchai-powered sets from Chinese packagers compete at the low end of Gulf tenders (typically below 1,000 kVA). Cummins Arabia's exposure is in price-led utility, telecom and construction bids in KSA and Kuwait rather than in data centres. Track Chinese packager registrations on Etimad and CAPT rather than Yuchai itself.
competitiveCards.summary: China Yuchai International, through Guangxi Yuchai Machinery, produces engines for generator sets alongside marine and industrial engines. No verified 2025 to 2026 Gulf distributor announcement, Gulf project or data centre product from Yuchai was found in this research.

competitiveCards.title: MHIET sets hydrogen co-firing specifications for KU series gas engines (3.65 to 5.75 MW)
competitiveCards.sowhat: KU series competes with Cummins HSK78G and larger gas engines in industrial CHP and grid support. Gulf gas engine demand from data centres and utilities is growing and Mitsubishi now has a hydrogen-ready spec to offer. Cummins Arabia should sharpen its own fuel flexibility story.
competitiveCards.summary: Up to 50% hydrogen by volume on 18KU30SI class engines for cogeneration, grid stability and power wheeling, available for new units and retrofits with minimal design change.

competitiveCards.sowhat: Third-party BESS integrators are packaging Cat gensets by default. In the Gulf, Cummins Arabia should court the BESS integrators and EPCs (not just end users) so that Cummins is the default genset in their bills of material.

competitiveCards.sowhat: The 10 MW medium-speed gas platform fills the gap between Cat high-speed gensets and Solar turbines, directly bracketing Cummins HSK78G and QSK95 gas offers for Gulf industrial and utility prime power. Cummins Arabia should expect Cat to bid gas plants at 10 to 100 MW in Saudi and Kuwait with a single-OEM stack by 2027.

Cummins Arabia should hold the reciprocating advantages (part-load efficiency, modular redundancy, N+1 flexibility) in its bid narrative.

competitiveCards.title: US state data centre moratoria (New York EO 62, New Jersey cost-sharing law) trigger Baird downgrade, CAT falls over 6%
competitiveCards.sowhat: If US data centre permitting slows, Cat will redirect gensets and sales focus to the Gulf where Saudi and UAE AI campuses face no such moratoria. That raises competitive intensity in KSA and UAE from late 2026. Cummins Arabia should assume more aggressive Cat dealer pricing on large nodes.

competitiveCards.sowhat: Al Mulla is now a multi-brand house covering small Generac sets up to large mtu units, which dilutes focus but also means it will compete across Cummins Arabia's whole Kuwait range. The opportunity is that mtu no longer has a dedicated Kuwait partner; Cummins Arabia can position single-brand accountability with Kuwait government and oil sector buyers.

competitiveCards.sowhat: This is the sales script Cummins Arabia will meet in Gulf data centre bids: a bigger single unit and a shorter delivery slot. Cummins Arabia needs firm factory slot commitments in its proposals and should quantify Cummins' service network and parts stock in KSA and UAE against Baudouin's thin local footprint.

competitiveCards.title: Zahid Tractor publishes updated Saudi branch map (22 to 24 branches) and a 75 years of partnership campaign
competitiveCards.sowhat: Zahid's network already covers every Saudi industrial cluster including the northern and southern regions where Cummins Arabia has thinner coverage. Any Cummins Arabia branch plan should be checked against this map to avoid opening where Cat service is already dense and to prioritise gaps.

competitiveCards.sowhat: Relevant to NEOM and UAE hydrogen showcase projects where zero carbon backup power will be specified. Cummins Arabia should be ready to discuss Cummins hydrogen engine roadmap when consultants raise this.

competitiveCards.title: Liebherr expands Colmar engine plant for Rehlko KD Series data centre demand
competitiveCards.sowhat: Engine supply was the constraint on KD Series volume. Doubling it removes a lead time argument Cummins Arabia could previously use in the 2 MW to 4 MW band. Expect more aggressive KD availability quotes into Gulf data centre projects from 2027.

competitiveCards.sowhat: The EMEA leadership now runs a standardised delivery model that can be extended to the Middle East through distributors. Cummins Arabia should expect more consistent Rehlko bids on Gulf data centre tenders led by UK and European consultants.

competitiveCards.sowhat: More US packaging capacity shortens Generac lead times for export orders in 2027. Cummins Arabia should expect Generac to quote competitive delivery on Gulf hyperscale sites from 2027.

competitiveCards.title: MHI-ESA headline partner at DCD Connect APAC 2026, pitching MGS-R and grid-to-chip resilience
competitiveCards.sowhat: Mitsubishi is marketing MGS as an AI data centre product in Asia. The same hyperscale and colocation operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should track which APAC operators standardise on MGS and prepare Gulf-specific counters.

competitiveCards.sowhat: Mitsubishi's dealer development effort is centred on Asia Pacific; the Middle East network is small (one dealer per Gulf country) and run from Sharjah. competitiveCards.sowhat: Zahid is standardising a digital, uptime-guarantee sales motion across machines, power and rental in the Kingdom. Cummins Arabia should expect connected-asset and uptime-guarantee terms to appear in Saudi genset bids and should have PowerCommand Cloud and service-level commitments ready as standard.
competitiveCards.summary: Three-day Sales Campus (13 to 15 January 2026) for the full Zahid sales organisation, product support, SMD and Ejar rental divisions with Caterpillar management and instructors, built around a customer-back approach, VisionLink, Cat Inspect and uptime guarantees.

competitiveCards.title: Volvo Penta introduces G17 natural gas engine for power generation, aimed at data centres and utilities
competitiveCards.sowhat: Adds a gas option at the 17 litre node for packagers. In the Gulf the relevant overlap is with Cummins gas gensets in the 400 to 700 kW band for oil and gas and utility sites in KSA and Kuwait.
competitiveCards.summary: First Volvo Penta natural gas genset engine, framed as lower-emission, scalable backup power for data centres, utilities and mission-critical infrastructure.

sec.read: First Volvo Penta natural gas genset engine, framed as lower-emission, scalable backup power for data centres, utilities and mission-critical infrastructure.

competitiveCards.title: First emergency gensets with verified Environmental Product Declarations: 16V4000 DS2500 and 10V1600
competitiveCards.sowhat: EPDs will be asked for by hyperscalers and by UAE and Saudi green building schemes. If a UAE data centre RFP requires EPDs, Cummins Arabia needs Cummins' equivalent documentation ready or it loses on a compliance line rather than on price.
competitiveCards.summary: Rolls-Royce delivered the first data centre gensets carrying externally verified EPDs published via Environdec to a European operator, positioning EPDs as a new transparency standard for critical power.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce delivered the first data centre gensets carrying externally verified EPDs published via Environdec to a European operator, positioning EPDs as a new transparency standard for critical power.

competitiveCards.title: Five-year guaranteed Series 4000 capacity agreement with UK packager AVK
competitiveCards.sowhat: Rolls-Royce is pre-selling Series 4000 capacity to European data centre packagers. That is good for Cummins Arabia in the short term because it leaves less uncommitted mtu volume for Gulf distributors, but it also signals mtu will prioritise hyperscaler channel partners; if a Gulf packager gets a similar deal, treat it as a direct threat.
competitiveCards.summary: Framework agreement secures Series 4000 emergency genset production capacity for AVK, exclusive mtu integrator for UK and Ireland, for five years, focused on HVO-ready data centre gensets. AVK has taken over 600 mtu gensets in the past decade.

sec.read: Framework agreement secures Series 4000 emergency genset production capacity for AVK, exclusive mtu integrator for UK and Ireland, for five years, focused on HVO-ready data centre gensets. AVK has taken over 600 mtu gensets in the past decade.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko launches all-new KD Series 60 to 600 kW generators
competitiveCards.sowhat: Below 600 kW is outside the large genset band but this unifies Rehlko's catalogue for distributors, which simplifies their selling and service story in the Gulf. Cummins Arabia's C-series coverage in the same band remains broader, and it should hold price discipline rather than react.
competitiveCards.summary: Rehlko extended the KD brand down into the 60 to 600 kW range, presenting it as a global standard in 80 to 600 kW power and consolidating its industrial lineup under one brand.

sec.read: Rehlko extended the KD brand down into the 60 to 600 kW range, presenting it as a global standard in 80 to 600 kW power and consolidating its industrial lineup under one brand.

competitiveCards.title: Volvo Penta positions itself as total power solutions provider for the digital infrastructure market at CONEXPO 2026
competitiveCards.sowhat: KJ Power is a Turkish packager active in Gulf tenders; Volvo BESS subsystems inside packager products would compete with Cummins BESS in rental and hybrid applications.
competitiveCards.summary: Volvo Penta announced it would show D8 Stage V/Tier 4 Final, BESS, electric driveline and its energy transition roadmap, and referenced BESS wins with KJ Power (Turkey), Aura Clean Energy and SEETEL.

sec.read: Volvo Penta announced it would show D8 Stage V/Tier 4 Final, BESS, electric driveline and its energy transition roadmap, and referenced BESS wins with KJ Power (Turkey), Aura Clean Energy and SEETEL.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko and Alghanem deliver data centre backup power in Jordan
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is the closest published Rehlko data centre reference to the Gulf. It shows Rehlko using long-tenured regional distributors for data centre wins in the Levant. The same Midis Group channel that serves Jordan also serves KSA, UAE and Kuwait, so replication in the Gulf is plausible.
competitiveCards.summary: DCD reported a Jordan data centre backup power project delivered by Rehlko with Alghanem Trading and Contracting, its exclusive Jordan distributor for over 25 years. Capacity and models were not published. The article also states Rehlko ranks third globally in generator manufacturing.

sec.read: DCD reported a Jordan data centre backup power project delivered by Rehlko with Alghanem Trading and Contracting, its exclusive Jordan distributor for over 25 years. Capacity and models were not published. The article also states Rehlko ranks third globally in generator manufacturing.

competitiveCards.title: Seven mtu 20V4000 DS3600 gensets for Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is mtu's first public Kuwait win through the new Al Mulla channel and it lands in the 3 MVA class where Cummins Arabia sells C3000 and C3500 class sets. A government airport reference plus a Turkish EPC relationship (Limak) gives mtu credibility for the next Kuwait infrastructure packages. Cummins Arabia should map Limak and other Turkish EPC procurement teams active in Kuwait and KSA.
competitiveCards.summary: Rolls-Royce is supplying seven 20-cylinder Series 4000 DS3600 backup gensets through local partner Al Mulla Power Systems for the Limak-built Terminal 2, awarded by DGCA with the Ministry of Public Works. Units are specified for 55 C ambient, delivery early 2026 then commissioning.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce is supplying seven 20-cylinder Series 4000 DS3600 backup gensets through local partner Al Mulla Power Systems for the Limak-built Terminal 2, awarded by DGCA with the Ministry of Public Works. Units are specified for 55 C ambient, delivery early 2026 then commissioning.

competitiveCards.title: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar exhibit together at ADIPEC 2025 in Abu Dhabi
competitiveCards.sowhat: Cat is keeping its oil and gas power and marine franchise warm with ADNOC-ecosystem buyers through the dealer. Cummins Arabia should track ADNOC and Lamprell type accounts where Al-Bahar has installed 3500 series sets and target the rebuild and CVA renewal cycle.
competitiveCards.summary: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar shared stand 9430 at ADIPEC 2025 (3 to 6 November, ADNEC), showcasing high-efficiency engines, rebuild programmes and data-driven lifecycle solutions for oil and gas customers.

sec.read: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar shared stand 9430 at ADIPEC 2025 (3 to 6 November, ADNEC), showcasing high-efficiency engines, rebuild programmes and data-driven lifecycle solutions for oil and gas customers.

competitiveCards.title: Baudouin publishes November 2025 data centre genset rating cards (50 and 60 Hz) covering WPG1900 to WPG5775
competitiveCards.sowhat: The 60 Hz card matters for Saudi Arabia: Baudouin now publishes DCR and DCP ratings at 1800 rpm including 13.8 kV medium voltage sets, which is what Saudi data centre specifications ask for. Cummins Arabia should benchmark its 60 Hz C2500 to C3500 DCC offers against the WPG2500B76 to WPG4000B76 band.
competitiveCards.summary: The 50 Hz card runs from WPG1900 (16M33G1900, 1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5775 (20M61G5940, 5,250 kVA DCP at 11 kV); the 60 Hz card runs from WPG1540B76 (1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5000B76 (20M61G5000, 6,250 kVA DCR at 13.8 kV). EPA Tier 2 genset models are available.

sec.read: The 50 Hz card runs from WPG1900 (16M33G1900, 1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5775 (20M61G5940, 5,250 kVA DCP at 11 kV); the 60 Hz card runs from WPG1540B76 (1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5000B76 (20M61G5000, 6,250 kVA DCR at 13.8 kV). EPA Tier 2 genset models are available.

competitiveCards.title: Generac standardises 1,000 to 1,500 kW US industrial diesel sets on Perkins 4008 (30.6 L) and 4012/D46L (45.8 L) engines
competitiveCards.sowhat: Perkins gains a large 60 Hz OEM volume base through Generac, which feeds 60 Hz product maturity relevant to Saudi Arabia. If Generac's Gulf dealers (Atlas Power Solutions, Watan Altaqa, Al Mulla) bring these sets to KSA, Cummins Arabia faces Perkins-powered 1,000 to 1,500 kW packages under a second brand.
competitiveCards.summary: Generac's SD1000/MD1000 use the Perkins 30.6 L 8 cylinder engine and the SD1250/MD1250 (1,250 and 1,500 kW nodes) use the Perkins D46L 12 cylinder engine with Deep Sea G8601 controllers.

sec.read: Generac's SD1000/MD1000 use the Perkins 30.6 L 8 cylinder engine and the SD1250/MD1250 (1,250 and 1,500 kW nodes) use the Perkins D46L 12 cylinder engine with Deep Sea G8601 controllers.

competitiveCards.title: Q3 2025: record USD 17.6 billion sales, Energy & Transportation USD 8.4 billion (+17%), backlog USD 39.8 billion led by data centre customers
competitiveCards.sowhat: Backlog growth driven by data centres means Cat factory slots are being consumed by US hyperscalers. In the near term this leaves room for Cummins Arabia on lead time in the Gulf; the window narrows as Cat capacity comes online.
competitiveCards.summary: Caterpillar posted all-time Q3 sales of USD 17.6 billion, Energy & Transportation sales of USD 8.4 billion up 17%, backlog up USD 2.4 billion in the quarter mainly from data centre customers, and full-year tariff cost guidance of USD 1.6 to 1.75 billion.

sec.read: Caterpillar posted all-time Q3 sales of USD 17.6 billion, Energy & Transportation sales of USD 8.4 billion up 17%, backlog up USD 2.4 billion in the quarter mainly from data centre customers, and full-year tariff cost guidance of USD 1.6 to 1.75 billion.

competitiveCards.title: Caterpillar commits USD 725 million to expand Lafayette large engine plant for 3500 series power generation engines
competitiveCards.sowhat: The 3512 and 3516 are the engines behind the gensets Cummins Arabia meets most often in Gulf tenders. More 3500 capacity shortens Cat lead times from 2027, which removes one of the few advantages Cummins has held while Cat allocated engines to US hyperscalers.
competitiveCards.summary: USD 725 million capital expansion at the Lafayette, Indiana large engine centre that builds Cat 3500 engines for power generation and data centre applications, plus a USD 100 million five-year US workforce pledge.

sec.read: USD 725 million capital expansion at the Lafayette, Indiana large engine centre that builds Cat 3500 engines for power generation and data centre applications, plus a USD 100 million five-year US workforce pledge.

competitiveCards.title: Mitsubishi Power unveils first locally assembled M501JAC gas turbine at Dammam, marking 60 years in Saudi Arabia
competitiveCards.sowhat: Mitsubishi Power's Saudi localisation is in gas turbines, not gensets, but it gives the Mitsubishi name Vision 2030 credibility with Aramco, SEC and the Eastern Province. If MHIET ever routes MGS assembly or service through Dammam, that would be a direct challenge. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Saudi localisation and IKTVA content visible to the same buyers.
competitiveCards.summary: The Dammam facility assembled its first JAC turbine, destined for the 475 MW Amiral cogeneration plant in Jubail (TAQA and JERA) serving SATORP. Mitsubishi Power reports over 50% Saudisation and partnerships with Saudi Aramco, SEC and SWCC.

sec.read: The Dammam facility assembled its first JAC turbine, destined for the 475 MW Amiral cogeneration plant in Jubail (TAQA and JERA) serving SATORP. Mitsubishi Power reports over 50% Saudisation and partnerships with Saudi Aramco, SEC and SWCC.

competitiveCards.title: Makeen becomes exclusive mtu distributor for stationary power across Saudi Arabia
competitiveCards.sowhat: For the first time mtu gensets have an exclusive Saudi channel owned by Aramco, HD Hyundai and Dussur, with a localisation licence behind it. That combination speaks directly to Aramco, SEC, NEOM and IKTVA-scored buyers that Cummins Arabia sells to. Cummins Arabia's answer is installed base, 60 Hz stock and its own local content record; it should expect Makeen to appear in Eastern Province industrial and data centre tenders within 12 months.
competitiveCards.summary: Effective 2025-10-01, Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (Makeen) extended its exclusive mtu distributorship from mobile applications to stationary power across the Kingdom, covering genuine parts, factory-certified MRO and integrated power solutions.

sec.read: Effective 2025-10-01, Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (Makeen) extended its exclusive mtu distributorship from mobile applications to stationary power across the Kingdom, covering genuine parts, factory-certified MRO and integrated power solutions.

competitiveCards.title: MHI-ESA launches containerised MGS2500R for data centres
competitiveCards.sowhat: A plug-in containerised 2.5 MVA set is the format UAE and Kuwait colocation builders ask for. Cummins Arabia should have a matching containerised C2500 or C2750 offer priced and documented for 50 Hz markets before Mitsubishi dealers bring this to Dubai.
competitiveCards.summary: Up to 2,500 kVA standby in a 40 ft high cube container, Critical Power and Data Center Continuous Power duty, Tier III and Tier IV compliant, launched at Data Centre World Asia 2025 in Singapore with an APAC 50 Hz focus.

sec.read: Up to 2,500 kVA standby in a 40 ft high cube container, Critical Power and Data Center Continuous Power duty, Tier III and Tier IV compliant, launched at Data Centre World Asia 2025 in Singapore with an APAC 50 Hz focus.

competitiveCards.title: Fast-start mtu 20V4000 gas gensets for data centre prime and backup power, 45 second start from 2026
competitiveCards.sowhat: This targets the same grid-constrained data centre prime power need that Cummins addresses with the HSK78G and QSK95 gas sets, and the 60 Hz variant is built for markets like Saudi Arabia. In UAE and KSA data centre campuses where gas is available, mtu can now bid diesel backup, gas prime and dynamic UPS as one package. Cummins Arabia should lead with HSK78G efficiency and Cummins' Gulf gas service record before mtu's 60 Hz set ships.
competitiveCards.summary: Rolls-Royce launched a 2.8 MW 20V4000 L64 gas genset with 10% better efficiency, 120 second start today and a 45 second start 60 Hz model from 2026, aimed at data centres waiting for grid connections. Existing gas genset fleets cited in the UK (500 plus), Canada and Jakarta.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce launched a 2.8 MW 20V4000 L64 gas genset with 10% better efficiency, 120 second start today and a 45 second start 60 Hz model from 2026, aimed at data centres waiting for grid connections. Existing gas genset fleets cited in the UK (500 plus), Canada and Jakarta.

competitiveCards.title: Largest ever mtu battery order: 582 MWh / 291 MW EnergyPack for Ignitis in Lithuania
competitiveCards.sowhat: mtu's BESS business is grid-scale and utility-led, unlike Cummins' BESS positioning. The relevance for Cummins Arabia is hybrid genset plus storage tenders in KSA and UAE, where mtu can now show half-gigawatt-hour references and its own controller. Cummins Arabia should track EnergyPack quotes into Saudi utility and NEOM-type microgrid work.
competitiveCards.summary: Three BESS sites at wind farms and a pumped storage plant, operational from 2027, controlled by mtu EnergetIQ Manager. Rolls-Royce cites over 200 mtu battery storage projects delivered worldwide.

sec.read: Three BESS sites at wind farms and a pumped storage plant, operational from 2027, controlled by mtu EnergetIQ Manager. Rolls-Royce cites over 200 mtu battery storage projects delivered worldwide.

competitiveCards.title: Rolls-Royce and Microsoft publish joint position paper on HVO for data centre backup power
competitiveCards.sowhat: A published Microsoft co-authorship is a hyperscaler endorsement mtu will reuse in UAE and Saudi data centre bids where Microsoft, and the operators building for it, specify backup fleets. Cummins Arabia should be ready with its own HVO approval documentation for the QSK series when hyperscaler specs arrive.
competitiveCards.summary: The paper positions HVO as a drop-in fuel cutting lifecycle CO2 by up to 90% on approved diesel gensets, written for the Singapore data centre sector with Microsoft's APAC cloud ESG team. Quoted: Ostermaier and Spadaro.

sec.read: The paper positions HVO as a drop-in fuel cutting lifecycle CO2 by up to 90% on approved diesel gensets, written for the Singapore data centre sector with Microsoft's APAC cloud ESG team. Quoted: Ostermaier and Spadaro.

competitiveCards.title: 50 mtu 12V4000 R64 engines ordered for Saudi Arabia's Dammam to Riyadh high-speed trains
competitiveCards.sowhat: Not a genset sale, but it puts 50 plus Series 4000 engines into Saudi Arabia with a service obligation, which strengthens the case for a Makeen Series 4000 parts and MRO base in the Eastern Province. That base would also serve stationary Series 4000 gensets sold against Cummins Arabia's QSK60 and QSK78 range.
competitiveCards.summary: Stadler ordered 50 mtu Series 4000 rail engines (1,500 kW each, EU Stage V) for 10 trains running up to 200 km/h, with an option for 40 more. The release stresses operation in extreme heat and sand.

sec.read: Stadler ordered 50 mtu Series 4000 rail engines (1,500 kW each, EU Stage V) for 10 trains running up to 200 km/h, with an option for 40 more. The release stresses operation in extreme heat and sand.

competitiveCards.title: Caterpillar launches Cat D1500 1.5 MW compact diesel genset on C32B engine
competitiveCards.sowhat: A 1.5 MW node on a 32 litre engine attacks the footprint and weight argument in the 1,500 to 1,875 kVA class where Cummins sells QSK50 based sets in Saudi 60 Hz projects. Watch for a 50 Hz and Middle East release; until then it is a North America product.
competitiveCards.summary: New D1500 60 Hz standby genset on the 32.1 litre C32B, up to 13% less floor space and 32% lighter than the previous 1.5 MW node, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency, targeted at North America first.

sec.read: New D1500 60 Hz standby genset on the 32.1 litre C32B, up to 13% less floor space and 32% lighter than the previous 1.5 MW node, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency, targeted at North America first.

competitiveCards.title: Joule, Caterpillar and Wheeler agree 4 GW data centre power in Utah on G3520K gensets with 1.1 GWh BESS
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is the template Cat will bring to Gulf data centre developers: gas gensets as prime power plus BESS in one dealer-led package. Cummins Arabia needs an equivalent prime power gas plus storage story for Saudi and UAE campuses before Cat dealers pitch it.
competitiveCards.summary: Joule Capital Partners, Caterpillar and dealer Wheeler Machinery announced an agreement for 4 GW of total energy for a 4,000 acre data centre campus in central Utah, using G3520K gas gensets with combined cooling heat and power and 1.1 GWh of grid-forming battery storage, launch targeted 2026.

sec.read: Joule Capital Partners, Caterpillar and dealer Wheeler Machinery announced an agreement for 4 GW of total energy for a 4,000 acre data centre campus in central Utah, using G3520K gas gensets with combined cooling heat and power and 1.1 GWh of grid-forming battery storage, launch targeted 2026.

competitiveCards.title: MTU Yuchai Power JV in Suzhou adds Series 2000 G06 and Series 4000 S83 production, 3,000 engines built to date
competitiveCards.sowhat: Chinese built mtu engines create a lower cost route for Chinese genset packagers exporting to the Gulf. Cummins Arabia already competes with Chinese packaged Cummins engines from Cummins' own China plants; mtu now has a comparable lever. Watch for Suzhou sourced mtu gensets appearing in UAE and KSA rental and construction tenders.
competitiveCards.summary: Rolls-Royce's Chinese JV with Guangxi Yuchai, established 2014, expanded its scope in 2024 and now builds Series 2000 and 4000 variants for data centres, rental, industrial parks and oil and gas, including for overseas projects in neighbouring regions.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce's Chinese JV with Guangxi Yuchai, established 2014, expanded its scope in 2024 and now builds Series 2000 and 4000 variants for data centres, rental, industrial parks and oil and gas, including for overseas projects in neighbouring regions.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko completes acquisition of The Wilmott Group (WB Power Services and Wiltech Acoustics)
competitiveCards.sowhat: Rehlko is building an end-to-end data centre delivery model in EMEA (engineering, enclosures, commissioning, service) rather than selling loose gensets. Gulf hyperscale customers procuring through UK and European consultants will see this offer. Cummins Arabia should be ready to quote full turnkey scope, not equipment only.
competitiveCards.summary: UK critical power integrator with 19 UK locations supporting over 4,000 critical power plants joined Rehlko, adding project engineering, acoustic enclosures and lifecycle service to its EMEA data centre offer.

sec.read: UK critical power integrator with 19 UK locations supporting over 4,000 critical power plants joined Rehlko, adding project engineering, acoustic enclosures and lifecycle service to its EMEA data centre offer.

competitiveCards.title: USD 75 million Aiken, South Carolina expansion to machine Series 4000 engines in the US from July 2027
competitiveCards.sowhat: A second Series 4000 engine source reduces mtu's single-plant dependency on Friedrichshafen, which has historically capped what its Gulf distributors could deliver in a given year. Monitor mtu lead-time quotes in KSA and UAE from 2027.
competitiveCards.summary: Phase 1 adds 37,000 sq ft (potential 60,000 sq ft) to the Aiken engine plant so Series 4000 components are machined in-country instead of shipped finished from Germany. Construction starts Q1 2026, production July 2027, 60 new jobs on a 434 person site.

sec.read: Phase 1 adds 37,000 sq ft (potential 60,000 sq ft) to the Aiken engine plant so Series 4000 components are machined in-country instead of shipped finished from Germany. Construction starts Q1 2026, production July 2027, 60 new jobs on a 434 person site.

competitiveCards.title: MHIET launches 450 kW gas cogeneration system capable of hydrogen co-firing
competitiveCards.sowhat: Small gas CHP is a Japan-first product. Gulf relevance is limited today but it signals Mitsubishi will pitch hydrogen-ready gas engines into Saudi and UAE decarbonisation programmes where Cummins gas gensets also compete.
competitiveCards.summary: Reliability verified through demonstration testing; part of MHIET's low carbon gas engine roadmap.

sec.read: Reliability verified through demonstration testing; part of MHIET's low carbon gas engine roadmap.

competitiveCards.title: USD 24 million Mankato expansion to lift Series 4000 genset output by more than 120% by 2026
competitiveCards.sowhat: Mankato builds 60 Hz sets, the frequency Saudi Arabia runs on. More 60 Hz Series 4000 capacity shortens the lead times mtu can quote into Saudi data centre and industrial tenders from 2026. Cummins Arabia's 60 Hz lead-time advantage in KSA narrows as this ramps.
competitiveCards.summary: Rolls-Royce announced a new Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, Minnesota to raise Series 4000 generator set production more than 120% by 2026 versus the prior year, adding over 100 jobs. Data centre sales grew almost 50% in 2024; Stratmann said hyperscale customers have relied on mtu for over 15 years.

competitiveCards.title: Jubaili Bros (Perkins packager) signs strategic partnership with Wholesale Electric Asia for oil and gas power packages
competitiveCards.sowhat: Jubaili Bros is scaling as a regional packager and now targets oil and gas packages, a core Cummins Arabia segment in KSA and Kuwait. competitiveCards.summary: Jubaili Bros (1,600 employees, 11 countries, 3 manufacturing plants, 1.5 GW annual capacity) and Singapore based WEA agreed to cooperate on power generation distribution and customised oil and gas packages across the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia.

sec.read: Jubaili Bros (1,600 employees, 11 countries, 3 manufacturing plants, 1.5 GW annual capacity) and Singapore based WEA agreed to cooperate on power generation distribution and customised oil and gas packages across the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia.

competitiveCards.title: Rehlko and Liebherr expand KD Series engine partnership
competitiveCards.sowhat: The KD engine is a Liebherr-derived design, so Rehlko depends on a single external engine partner for its flagship range. Cummins Arabia can position Cummins in-house engine design, manufacturing and Gulf parts stock as a supply certainty argument in tenders.
competitiveCards.summary: Rehlko announced an expanded partnership with Liebherr for next generation KD Series generators, securing engine supply for the range that competes with Cummins QSK series in the 1 MW to 4 MW band.

sec.read: Rehlko announced an expanded partnership with Liebherr for next generation KD Series generators, securing engine supply for the range that competes with Cummins QSK series in the 1 MW to 4 MW band.

competitiveCards.title: Baudouin platinum sponsor at Middle East Energy 2025: 20M61 genset (6,250 kVA) pre-launch, 6M31 Stage V PowerKit, 20M55 gas genset
competitiveCards.sowhat: A 6,250 kVA single unit outranks Cummins' largest diesel node and is aimed at hyperscale campuses in the UAE and KSA. Cummins Arabia's counter is the installed base, Cummins factory paralleling and controls, service depth and proven 50 degree C performance. It should also test Baudouin's lead-time claims against real Cummins slot availability when quoting.
competitiveCards.summary: At Dubai World Trade Centre (stand S3.B40 and outdoor OS.90), Baudouin revealed the 20M61 data centre genset up to 6,250 kVA, launched the 6M31 Stage V-ready PowerKit and showed a 20M55 gas genset up to 5,250 kVA, 12M33 plus SCR Stage V and 6M16 Stage V. CEO Fabrizio Mozzi called it the largest genset available for critical backup power. Baudouin claimed best lead times in the market.

competitiveCards.title: Perkins brings new 2606 (13 L) and 5012 (46 L) engines to Middle East Energy 2025 in Dubai
competitiveCards.sowhat: The 5012 sits exactly on the 1,250 to 1,875 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSK50 and QSK60 based sets into data centres and hospitals, and it is offered to every independent packager in the Gulf. The 2606 attacks the 350 to 550 kVA band with 1,000 hour service intervals. competitiveCards.summary: Perkins showcased the 2606 (350 to 550 kVA at 50 Hz, available H2 2025, 1,000 hour service intervals, HVO and B100 capable) and the electronic 5012 (1,275 to 1,875 kVA at 50 Hz, 1,125 to 1,500 kWe at 60 Hz, ISO G3, NFPA110, EPA Tier 2 on 60 Hz).
