competitiveCards.title: MHI-ESA adds MGS assembly plant in Johor Bahru, Malaysia with WDG Assembly
competitiveCards.sowhat: Extra MGS capacity in Asia shortens lead times for Gulf orders that ship from Singapore. Cummins Arabia should expect Mitsubishi dealers in KSA and UAE to quote firmer delivery on 1.5 MVA to 2.75 MVA sets.
competitiveCards.summary: New production hub for MGS units to meet rising data centre and critical infrastructure demand in Southeast Asia, alongside Singapore and Vietnam assembly.

sec.read: New production hub for MGS units to meet rising data centre and critical infrastructure demand in Southeast Asia, alongside Singapore and Vietnam assembly.

competitiveCards.title: Upgraded mtu Series 1600 gensets launched for 50 Hz market, 590 to 996 kVA
competitiveCards.sowhat: This pushes mtu down into the 600 to 1,000 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in volume for UAE and Kuwait 50 Hz projects. mtu's argument is data centre grade load factors and HVO approval on a compact 22 litre engine. Cummins Arabia should hold the position on price, lead time and local stock, which mtu's distributors cannot match in this band.
competitiveCards.summary: New 12V1600 Gx1 based gensets deliver up to 40% more power than the predecessor, are approved for HVO (EN 15940), meet ISO 8528-5 class G3 and carry 100% load factor ratings for data centre use. Aimed at data centres, healthcare, commercial buildings and edge sites; the 60 Hz version launched in late 2023.

sec.read: New 12V1600 Gx1 based gensets deliver up to 40% more power than the predecessor, are approved for HVO (EN 15940), meet ISO 8528-5 class G3 and carry 100% load factor ratings for data centre use. Aimed at data centres, healthcare, commercial buildings and edge sites; the 60 Hz version launched in late 2023.

competitiveCards.title: Zahid Tractor marks 75 years as Caterpillar's Saudi dealer at Jeddah flagship branch
competitiveCards.sowhat: The Zahid relationship is the deepest dealer franchise in the Kingdom and is not going to be disrupted. Cummins Arabia should not expect Cat account churn in KSA from dealer instability; wins have to come on product, lead time and service economics.
competitiveCards.summary: Zahid Tractor and Caterpillar executives, key clients and employees from across the Kingdom gathered at the Jeddah flagship branch to mark 75 years of the dealership, coinciding with Caterpillar's 2025 centennial.

sec.read: Zahid Tractor and Caterpillar executives, key clients and employees from across the Kingdom gathered at the Jeddah flagship branch to mark 75 years of the dealership, coinciding with Caterpillar's 2025 centennial.

competitiveCards.title: Baudouin exhibits at Data Center Nation Riyadh with 2,000 to 5,250 kVA M33 and M55 gensets
competitiveCards.sowhat: Direct marketing into the Saudi data centre pipeline. Cummins Arabia should make sure Saudi data centre consultants and EPCs have Cummins DCC ratings, 60 Hz performance data and local service commitments in hand before Baudouin's lead-time pitch lands.
competitiveCards.summary: Baudouin presented its data centre genset range and previewed the 20M55 to Saudi operators and developers, citing Uptime Institute pre-approval and ISO 8528 G3 load acceptance.

sec.read: Baudouin presented its data centre genset range and previewed the 20M55 to Saudi operators and developers, citing Uptime Institute pre-approval and ISO 8528 G3 load acceptance.

competitiveCards.title: Jubaili Bros adds MWM gas gensets (400 to 4,500 kW) for Middle East and Africa
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is context for the Perkins channel: Jubaili now covers diesel (Perkins) and gas (MWM), which lets it bid full gas and diesel packages against Cummins Arabia's HSK78G and diesel range. Included as a late 2024 baseline because it shapes 2025 to 2026 bidding behaviour.
competitiveCards.summary: MWM (Mannheim) and Jubaili Bros (Dubai) announced a partnership to offer MWM gas generators of 400 to 4,500 kW electrical across MEA, under Group CEO Dr Marcus Schumacher.

sec.read: MWM (Mannheim) and Jubaili Bros (Dubai) announced a partnership to offer MWM gas generators of 400 to 4,500 kW electrical across MEA, under Group CEO Dr Marcus Schumacher.

competitiveCards.title: Baudouin launches complete generator sets for data centres, 2,000 to 5,250 kVA (baseline)
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is the structural change: Baudouin now bids as a single-brand genset supplier, not just an engine to local packagers, and it targets the same hyperscale and colocation buyers Cummins Arabia courts in Riyadh, Dammam, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Cummins Arabia should expect Baudouin gensets in consultant shortlists from 2025 onward.
competitiveCards.summary: Baudouin moved from engines only to complete M33 and M55 gensets for data centres with Uptime Institute pre-approved units and announced the 20M55 genset (4,250 to 5,250 kVA). Manufacturing sites listed in India, China, Russia, Italy, Germany, France and the US.

sec.read: Baudouin moved from engines only to complete M33 and M55 gensets for data centres with Uptime Institute pre-approved units and announced the 20M55 genset (4,250 to 5,250 kVA). Manufacturing sites listed in India, China, Russia, Italy, Germany, France and the US.

competitiveCards.title: Kohler Energy rebrands as Rehlko under Platinum Equity ownership
competitiveCards.sowhat: Private equity ownership means Rehlko is being run for growth and exit, with capital allocated to data centre gensets. The Kohler-SDMO brand equity in the Gulf is being migrated to Rehlko, which creates a window where distributor and end-user recognition is weaker. Cummins Arabia should press its brand continuity with consultants and data centre EPCs during this transition.
competitiveCards.summary: Platinum Equity completed its acquisition of a majority stake in May 2024 and the business took the Rehlko name on 17 September 2024, with Kohler Co. remaining an investment partner. Portfolio listed as Power Systems, Engines, Uninterruptible Power, Home Energy, Clarke Energy, Curtis Instruments and Heila Technologies, across 100 plus locations.

sec.read: Platinum Equity completed its acquisition of a majority stake in May 2024 and the business took the Rehlko name on 17 September 2024, with Kohler Co. remaining an investment partner. Portfolio listed as Power Systems, Engines, Uninterruptible Power, Home Energy, Clarke Energy, Curtis Instruments and Heila Technologies, across 100 plus locations.

competitiveCards.title: Baudouin joins the Gulf Data Centre Association (GCDA) alongside Italian and Spanish data centre associations (baseline)
competitiveCards.sowhat: GCDA membership gives Baudouin a seat in the Gulf data centre community and its events. Cummins Arabia should confirm its own visibility in GCDA programmes so Baudouin does not become the default OEM voice there.
competitiveCards.summary: Baudouin announced collaborations with GCDA (covering Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE), IDA (Italy) and SPAIN DC, promoting M Series engines 25 to 4,150 kVA with cooling above 50 degree C ambient and HVO testing.

sec.read: Baudouin announced collaborations with GCDA (covering Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE), IDA (Italy) and SPAIN DC, promoting M Series engines 25 to 4,150 kVA with cooling above 50 degree C ambient and HVO testing.

competitiveCards.title: MHIET launches MGS3100R, a 3,000 kVA class set with common rail S16R2 engine
competitiveCards.sowhat: This is Mitsubishi's answer to the 2.5 MW to 3 MW data centre node that Cummins serves with QSK78 and QSK95 based sets. It is not yet on the Middle East catalogue, which caps Mitsubishi's Gulf offer at 2,750 kVA until MHIES-ME adopts MGS-R. Cummins Arabia should keep quoting above 2.75 MVA where Mitsubishi cannot follow locally.
competitiveCards.summary: MGS3100R rated 3,025 kVA standby / critical power and 2,750 kVA prime / data centre continuous at 50 Hz, 6,785 x 2,820 x 3,170 mm, 23,100 kg dry, ISO 8528-5 G3 and NFPA 110, assembled in Singapore and Vietnam for factories, hospitals and data centres in Asia Pacific. MHIET stated MGS had sold over 12,000 units to date.

sec.read: MGS3100R rated 3,025 kVA standby / critical power and 2,750 kVA prime / data centre continuous at 50 Hz, 6,785 x 2,820 x 3,170 mm, 23,100 kg dry, ISO 8528-5 G3 and NFPA 110, assembled in Singapore and Vietnam for factories, hospitals and data centres in Asia Pacific. MHIET stated MGS had sold over 12,000 units to date.

competitiveCards.title: Volvo Penta launches D17, its most powerful genset engine (TWD1744GE, 758 kVA prime at 50 Hz) (baseline)
competitiveCards.sowhat: Lifts Volvo's ceiling to about 880 kVA standby at 60 Hz, which puts Volvo-powered packager sets against Cummins QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in Saudi commercial and industrial standby. Above that band Volvo has no offer.
competitiveCards.summary: 17.26 litre six cylinder with dual-stage turbochargers and common rail, EPA Tier 2 certified for stationary emergency, dual speed 1500/1800 rpm, service interval up to 1,000 hours; 50 Hz prime 758 kVA, standby 833 kVA; 60 Hz prime 801 kVA, standby 881 kVA.

sec.read: 17.26 litre six cylinder with dual-stage turbochargers and common rail, EPA Tier 2 certified for stationary emergency, dual speed 1500/1800 rpm, service interval up to 1,000 hours; 50 Hz prime 758 kVA, standby 833 kVA; 60 Hz prime 801 kVA, standby 881 kVA.

competitiveCards.title: FG Wilson appoints Roger Kennedy as General Manager
competitiveCards.sowhat: A commercially oriented GM tends to prioritise dealer growth and volume. Combined with the Catalyst 2026 conference, this points to a growth push rather than a hold strategy for FG Wilson.
competitiveCards.summary: Roger Kennedy, a 30 year FG Wilson veteran with a commercial background, was appointed General Manager to lead the FG Wilson team worldwide.

sec.read: Roger Kennedy, a 30 year FG Wilson veteran with a commercial background, was appointed General Manager to lead the FG Wilson team worldwide.

competitiveCards.title: Volvo Penta adds D13 power node TAD1346GE 500 kVA
competitiveCards.sowhat: 500 kVA is the most contested packager node in the Gulf commercial market; a D13 at 500 kVA competes with Cummins QSX15 based sets on price through packagers.
competitiveCards.summary: New D13 rating described as reliable, compact and fuel-efficient addition to the power offer.

sec.read: New D13 rating described as reliable, compact and fuel-efficient addition to the power offer.

marketCards.title: HUMAIN Al-Saad 6 GW AI data centre campus
marketCards.meta: Data centre · Saudi Arabia · EPC award
marketCards.sowhat: The substations are ordered, so plot-level data hall EPCs and their genset packages are the next procurement wave, likely 2027 into 2028. HUMAIN and its plot tenants (AirTrunk, hyperscalers) will spec through Hatch and JLL. Cummins Arabia should be qualified with HUMAIN's design consultants and with Al Yamama now, and have C3000D6 and C3500 class data centre ratings ready for a 60 Hz Riyadh ambient derate discussion.
marketCards.summary: Al Yamama Company for Trading and Contracting wins the enabling infrastructure contract for HUMAIN's 6 GW AI data centre campus at Al Saad, east Riyadh: 380/132/33 kV distribution network, 500 MVA and 200 MVA substations, 2,000 MVA bulk supply point, water, fire, sewage and roads across a 24 sq km site. Tender issued 4 May 2026 under early contractor involvement, bids closed 8 May 2026, consultants Hatch, Egis and JLL.

sec.read: Six 1 GW plots. Backup generation is not in this package; data hall developers will each specify N+1 or 2N standby diesel at roughly 1.1 to 1.3 times critical IT load, so the first 1 GW plot alone implies well over 1 GW of standby genset capacity in 2,500 to 3,500 kVA blocks, 60 Hz.

marketCards.title: AWS Saudi Arabia region expansion and UAE zone rebuild
marketCards.sowhat: AWS is shifting Gulf capacity toward Saudi Arabia. Hyperscaler genset packages are placed through global agreements, but hardening requirements after the strikes (dispersed, protected genset yards, longer fuel autonomy) will be set locally. Cummins Arabia should be in front of AWS's Saudi construction team with resilience-focused packaging.
marketCards.summary: AWS says it cannot restore data in its Bahrain region or one of three UAE availability zones after Iranian strikes, offers no rebuild timeline for UAE or Bahrain, and states it plans three additional data zones in Saudi Arabia.

sec.read: Three new Saudi availability zones, each a multi-building campus, implies several hundred MW of standby diesel at 2,750 to 3,500 kVA, 60 Hz. A UAE zone rebuild, if it proceeds, adds 50 Hz demand.

marketCards.title: MEW post-strike restoration and grid hardening
marketCards.sowhat: Kuwait avoided a summer collapse through demand cuts, not new capacity. The 2027 budget cycle (starting April 2027) is where hardening spend lands, and MEW buys through CAPT with local agents. Cummins Arabia should have a Kuwaiti agent positioned with MEW's generation and distribution sectors before tenders appear in early 2027, and a rental partner ready for summer 2027 emergency capacity.
marketCards.summary: Kuwait's electricity minister says maintenance on several units damaged by Iranian attacks on power and desalination plants, fuel tanks and transmission lines was gradually completed by end August 2026; peak load reached 17,540 MW; the ministry ran conservation campaigns, cut government hours and curtailed factory lines. Unrelated station faults blacked out parts of Hawally and Mubarak Al-Kabeer on 6 September 2026.

sec.read: MEW and government facility owners will fund backup and black-start capacity: distributed standby diesel at substations, pumping stations and public buildings in 500 to 3,000 kVA units, 50 Hz, and possibly rental or fast-track prime power ahead of summer 2027.

marketCards.title: DataVolt / HUMAIN Oxagon AI data centre
marketCards.sowhat: DataVolt markets net zero, so the standby specification will be contested between diesel with HVO, gas gensets and BESS. Cummins Arabia can offer all three (C3500 class diesel, HSK78G gas, BESS) and should pitch the mixed architecture to DataVolt's engineers in 2027 before the EPC tender.
marketCards.summary: HUMAIN and DataVolt agree to jointly develop 100 MW of a 360 MW first-phase AI data centre at Oxagon, NEOM, first 100 MW operational in 2028, within DataVolt's planned 1.5 GW Oxagon campus.

sec.read: 360 MW first phase implies 400 MW plus of standby diesel or gas generation in 2,500 to 3,500 kVA units, 60 Hz, unless NEOM's renewable-plus-storage supply is accepted as the redundancy layer.

marketCards.title: Microsoft Saudi Arabia East cloud region
marketCards.meta: Data centre · Saudi Arabia · Genset package expected
marketCards.sowhat: Launch capacity gensets are already installed. The opportunity is service on the installed fleet and the expansion phases, which Microsoft procures through global frameworks. Cummins Arabia's job is to ensure Cummins' global Microsoft relationship is executed locally with Eastern Province service commitments.
marketCards.summary: Microsoft confirms the Saudi Arabia East datacenter region (three availability zones, Eastern Province) will be available in November 2026, with an Innovation Hub and HUMAIN partnership.

sec.read: Initial zones are built; expansion halls and second-wave sites will need additional standby diesel in 2,750 to 3,500 kVA blocks, 60 Hz, from 2027.

marketCards.title: ADNOC Gas Rich Gas Development Phases 2 and 3
marketCards.meta: Oil and gas · UAE · EPC award
marketCards.sowhat: Wison and Tecnimont will issue genset RFQs within 12 months against ADNOC's approved vendor list. Post-strike, ADNOC is likely to increase emergency generation redundancy, which enlarges the package. Confirm ADNOC vendor status and quote early to both EPCs.
marketCards.summary: ADNOC Gas awards USD 8.2 billion in EPC contracts: Wison Engineering for a new gas processing train at Habshan (USD 3.9 billion) and Tecnimont for a new NGL fractionation train at Ruwais (USD 4.3 billion), part of a USD 28 billion 2026 to 2030 programme.

sec.read: Emergency and essential-services diesel gensets for each train and substation, 1,000 to 2,750 kVA, 50 Hz, plus construction prime power at Habshan and Ruwais, both of which sustained strike damage in 2026.

marketCards.tags: watch Oil and gas Diesel gensets

marketCards.title: King Salman International Airport, Terminal 6
marketCards.sowhat: Substructure is under way, so the main terminal building and MEP contracts follow in 2027 and the genset schedule will be fixed by the airport's MEP consultant. Target the consultant's approved vendor list now; Caterpillar via Zahid will use its Riyadh airport references.
marketCards.summary: King Salman International Airport awards SAR 800 million (USD 213 million) enabling and substructure works on Terminal 6 to a China Civil Engineering Construction and Mofarreh AlHarbi JV; the terminal adds 40 million passengers a year and is due before Expo 2030. Prequalification received in early July 2026 for the east-west corridor and landside access roads.

sec.read: Terminal standby power for life safety, baggage, IT and airfield lighting, typically tens of MW in 2,000 to 3,000 kVA units, 60 Hz, tendered with the main terminal MEP package.

marketCards.title: Qiddiya high-speed rail
marketCards.sowhat: Rail systems integrators (Alstom, Siemens Mobility, Hitachi, CRRC consortia) carry their own genset frameworks. Engage the civil and systems bidders during tender so Cummins is named as an acceptable alternative in the technical submission.
marketCards.summary: Qiddiya Investment Company plans to tender a high-speed rail link connecting King Salman International Airport and KAFD with Qiddiya City in September 2026.

sec.read: Traction substations, stations and depots each need standby diesel, typically 500 to 2,000 kVA, 60 Hz, specified by the rail systems contractor.

marketCards.title: South Saad Al-Abdullah and South Sabah Al-Ahmad new cities
marketCards.sowhat: Substation EPCs in Kuwait (Alghanim, Al-Dhow, HEISCO, Larsen and Toubro) buy station gensets against MEW approved vendor lists. Confirm Cummins approval status with MEW and quote to the substation bidders.
marketCards.summary: Kuwait tenders power infrastructure packages covering substations and underground cable works for the South Saad Al-Abdullah and South Sabah Al-Ahmad residential projects.

sec.read: Substation auxiliary standby gensets (250 to 1,100 kVA, 50 Hz) and later standby for schools, clinics and government buildings in both cities.

marketCards.title: Expo 2030 Riyadh site
marketCards.meta: Construction / Events · Saudi Arabia · EPC award
marketCards.sowhat: Utilities contractors Al Yamama and Nesma are the immediate buyers of site power. Offer sale or rental hybrids to them in 2026; the permanent pavilion standby packages come with the building contracts in 2027 to 2028.
marketCards.summary: Expo 2030 Riyadh awards two main utilities and infrastructure works packages to Al Yamama Company, following the first package to Nesma and Partners in December 2025: internal roads, water, sewage, electricity, telecoms and EV charging across the 6 million sq m site, preparing for pavilion construction.

sec.read: Construction-phase prime power for contractors from 2026, then permanent standby for pavilions, transport and command facilities before 2030. Both phases sit in the 500 to 2,750 kVA band, 60 Hz, with a large rental component during build.

marketCards.title: Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2
marketCards.sowhat: The equipment decision is past, but the operator (DGCA) will tender O&M for the terminal's power plant after handover. A service bid with a Kuwaiti partner in 2027 is realistic, and airport hardening after the drone strikes may add standby capacity.
marketCards.summary: Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2 (Limak, USD 4.3 billion plus) is about 81 percent complete with civil works completion targeted 30 November 2026 and passenger operations in late 2026; the new third runway and control tower opened late 2025.

sec.read: Terminal standby gensets are installed; the opportunity is commissioning support, service contracts and additional resilience capacity after the 2026 drone strikes on the airport, 50 Hz.

marketCards.title: NREP Round 7 grid connections
marketCards.sowhat: Substation EPCs (Al Toukhi, Alfanar, Al Gihaz, Hyundai, Larsen and Toubro) buy station gensets on price and approved vendor status with Saudi Energy. Confirm Cummins' vendor approval for station service gensets and quote to all shortlisted EPCs.
marketCards.summary: Saudi Energy (formerly SEC) invites bids for nine 380 kV bulk supply points and overhead lines for National Renewable Energy Program Round 7 wind and PV projects (Ashayrah, Mozeraah, Mastura, East Al-Amoah, North Asir, Tumair, Al-Majmaah, NIFI, Starah), about 5,300 MW combined.

sec.read: Each 380 kV substation requires station auxiliary standby diesel, typically 500 to 1,250 kVA, 60 Hz, and the wind and PV plants need construction power plus O&M building standby.

marketCards.title: Az-Zour North IWPP Phase 2 and 3
marketCards.sowhat: SEPCO III will run a Chinese-led procurement and default to its habitual genset vendor unless ACWA Power's O&M arm insists on a brand with Kuwait service. ACWA Operations is the lever; Cummins Arabia's Saudi relationship with ACWA is the way in.
marketCards.summary: ACWA Power and Gulf Investment Corporation consortium (Gulf Alliance for Power and Water, with KAPP holding 60 percent) signs a 25 year energy conversion and water purchase agreement with MEW for Az-Zour North Phase 2 and 3 IWPP: 2,700 MW and about 545,500 m3/day SWRO, USD 4.1 billion, EPC led by SEPCO III with GE Vernova gas turbines.

sec.read: Plant emergency diesel and black-start generation for a 2,700 MW CCGT and large SWRO plant, several units in the 2,000 to 3,500 kVA band, 50 Hz, plus construction prime power.

marketCards.title: Ras Mohaisen IWP
marketCards.meta: Water / Desalination · Saudi Arabia · EPC award
marketCards.sowhat: Financial close triggers EPC procurement within months. Desalination developers (ACWA Power, Acciona, GS Inima consortia) reuse their previous plant genset vendor; find out who supplied the last SWPC plant by the same EPC and displace on service terms.
marketCards.summary: Saudi Water Partnership Company announces financial close for the Ras Mohaisen independent water desalination plant, valued at over SAR 2.5 billion (about USD 686 million).

sec.read: SWRO plant emergency and black-start diesel for intake, high-pressure pumps and controls, typically two to four units of 1,500 to 3,000 kVA, 60 Hz.

marketCards.title: Mubarak Al-Kabeer Port, Boubyan Island
marketCards.sowhat: Boubyan has weak grid supply, so construction power is a genuine prime-power job now, and CCCC will rent or buy locally. Position through Kuwaiti rental houses and CCCC's Kuwait procurement office in 2026; the permanent standby package follows with the terminal MEP in 2028.
marketCards.summary: Mubarak Al-Kabeer Port enters implementation: China Communications Construction Company holds the USD 4 billion EPC for Phase 1 (1,200 m container terminal, 2.7 million TEU), awarded December 2025, with supervision starting January 2026 and later phases to exceed 8 million TEU.

sec.read: Remote island site: multi-MW construction prime power from 2026, then terminal standby for cranes, reefer yards, buildings and navigation systems in 1,000 to 3,000 kVA units, 50 Hz.

marketCards.title: Aramco Jafurah gas development, Phases 3 to 5
marketCards.meta: Oil and gas · Saudi Arabia · EPC award
marketCards.sowhat: Aramco emergency gensets are bought by the EPC against Aramco's approved manufacturer list. Cummins Arabia should hold pre-agreed pricing with Tecnicas Reunidas, Sinopec and the Phase 5 bidders; the same EPCs also supply rental prime power for construction camps.
marketCards.summary: Aramco receives solicitation of interest responses for Jafurah unconventional gas Phase 5: EPC of three gas compression plants at 200 million cf/d each, FEED by Wood; main EPC tender expected from end 2025. Phase 3 (Tecnicas Reunidas and Sinopec, USD 2.24 billion) includes a 230 kV substation and utilities.

sec.read: Emergency and essential-services diesel gensets at each compression plant and substation, 1,000 to 2,500 kVA, 60 Hz, plus construction-phase prime power at remote sites.

marketCards.tags: watch Oil and gas Diesel gensets

marketCards.title: Khazna Dammam 200 MW campus
marketCards.sowhat: Khazna's UAE fleet standard is the reference; whoever holds Khazna's UAE genset framework will be the default in Dammam. Cummins Arabia's Dammam base gives it a service argument the UAE incumbent cannot match locally. First phase genset orders should land in the second half of 2026 or early 2027.
marketCards.summary: Khazna Data Centers acquires 225,000 sq m in Dammam for a 200 MW AI-ready campus, its first in Saudi Arabia, with initial capacity targeted in 9 to 12 months and full build in stages; part of a 400 MW Saudi plan and USD 2.62 billion regional financing.

sec.read: 200 MW IT load, roughly 230 to 260 MW of standby diesel in 2,500 to 3,500 kVA blocks, 60 Hz, delivered in phases from late 2026.

marketCards.title: Stargate UAE, Abu Dhabi
marketCards.meta: Data centre · UAE · Genset package expected
marketCards.sowhat: Khazna is the largest single genset buyer in the UAE for the next three years. If Cummins is not on Phase 1, the Phase 2 specification cycle in 2026 to 2027 is the entry point, and the argument is delivery slots and service capacity, since all OEMs are supply constrained on 3 MW class data centre sets.
marketCards.summary: Khazna says the first 200 MW phase of Stargate UAE in Abu Dhabi (19.2 sq km campus, part of the 5 GW UAE-US AI campus) will complete in the third quarter of 2026, with full 1 GW within three years; more than 5,000 workers on site.

sec.read: Phase 1 gensets are installed or in commissioning. Phases 2 onward (800 MW) imply roughly 900 MW plus of standby in 2,750 to 3,500 kVA units, 50 Hz, ordered through 2027 and 2028.

marketCards.title: Diriyah giga-project
marketCards.meta: Construction / Hospitality · Saudi Arabia · EPC award
marketCards.sowhat: Diriyah standardises MEP specifications across districts, so one approved genset brand tends to repeat. Getting on the Diriyah master specification is worth more than any single package.
marketCards.summary: Diriyah Company awards USD 1.5 billion of construction contracts for the Media and Innovation district and King Khalid Road.

sec.read: District-level standby for hotels, museums and media studios, many units in the 500 to 2,000 kVA band, 60 Hz, plus construction prime power during 2026 to 2028.

marketCards.title: Microsoft and G42 200 MW UAE expansion
marketCards.meta: Data centre · UAE · Genset package expected
marketCards.sowhat: Timing means genset orders are being placed now. Any slot Cummins can offer in 2026 or early 2027 is a competitive weapon while other OEMs quote 2028 deliveries.
marketCards.summary: Microsoft and G42 announce a 200 MW UAE data centre capacity expansion, developed by Khazna, expected live before the end of 2026, within Microsoft's USD 15.2 billion UAE commitment.

sec.read: About 230 to 260 MW of standby diesel in 2,750 to 3,500 kVA units, 50 Hz, with orders placed in 2026 to meet a year-end go-live.

marketCards.title: Sabah Al-Ahmad and Al-Mutlaa medical cities
marketCards.sowhat: Design consultants will be appointed in 2026 to 2027 and genset packages tendered through CAPT with the main contractors around 2028. Caterpillar via Al-Bahar and Al Mulla's genset division are the entrenched Kuwaiti hospital suppliers; the specification stage is where that default is contested.
marketCards.summary: Kuwait's Council of Ministers instructs the Ministry of Health to prepare initial plans for two medical cities, Sabah Al-Ahmad and Al-Mutlaa, each with two 500 bed hospitals plus clinics, dialysis, rehabilitation, staff housing and warehouses.

sec.read: Four 500 bed hospitals imply roughly 8 to 16 standby gensets of 1,500 to 2,500 kVA, 50 Hz, plus smaller sets for ancillary buildings.

techCards.title: Rehlko launches programme to double Changzhou backup power capacity from 5.5 GW to 11 GW
techCards.sowhat: Changzhou explicitly serves EMEA, so Gulf distributors can now source KD Series up to 4,000 kW from a plant with 11 GW annual capacity. This is a direct supply and price lever against Cummins Arabia in KSA, UAE and Kuwait data centre and industrial tenders. Cummins Arabia should benchmark Changzhou-sourced pricing on 1.5 MW to 3 MW sets and reinforce total cost of ownership and local service arguments.
techCards.summary: Changzhou builds generator systems from 6 kW to 4,000 kW and key components, serving China, Southeast Asia, EMEA and Latin America; CEO called it a critical hub for EMEA. The 11 GW target is to be reached without expanding the footprint; first pass yield up from 93% to 98%.

sec.read: Changzhou builds generator systems from 6 kW to 4,000 kW and key components, serving China, Southeast Asia, EMEA and Latin America; CEO called it a critical hub for EMEA. The 11 GW target is to be reached without expanding the footprint; first pass yield up from 93% to 98%.

techCards.title: MHIET sets hydrogen co-firing specifications for KU series gas engines (3.65 to 5.75 MW)
techCards.sowhat: KU series competes with Cummins HSK78G and larger gas engines in industrial CHP and grid support. Gulf gas engine demand from data centres and utilities is growing and Mitsubishi now has a hydrogen-ready spec to offer. Cummins Arabia should sharpen its own fuel flexibility story.
techCards.summary: Up to 50% hydrogen by volume on 18KU30SI class engines for cogeneration, grid stability and power wheeling, available for new units and retrofits with minimal design change.

sec.read: Up to 50% hydrogen by volume on 18KU30SI class engines for cogeneration, grid stability and power wheeling, available for new units and retrofits with minimal design change.

techCards.title: Rehlko invests EUR 12 million to expand Cholet, France switchgear plant
techCards.sowhat: Rehlko is shortening lead times on the paralleling switchgear that ships with large genset packages to EMEA including the Gulf. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own switchgear lead times and partner capacity so it is not outpaced on complete package delivery.
techCards.summary: 56% expansion of manufacturing space over five years, 30% lead time reduction on completion in November 2026, over 100 new jobs; Cholet builds LV main switchboards, generator switchboards and control panels for data centre solutions.

sec.read: 56% expansion of manufacturing space over five years, 30% lead time reduction on completion in November 2026, over 100 new jobs; Cholet builds LV main switchboards, generator switchboards and control panels for data centre solutions.

techCards.title: Mankato logistics centre opens; Series 4000 genset capacity more than doubles by end 2026
techCards.sowhat: Doubled 60 Hz Series 4000 output is the supply side of a future push into Saudi Arabia's 60 Hz data centre market. Lead time, not product, has been mtu's Gulf weakness; from 2027 that argument weakens for Cummins Arabia in KSA.
techCards.summary: Rolls-Royce cut the ribbon on the 250,000 sq ft, USD 24 million Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, stating genset production capacity more than doubles by end of 2026 and that its backup systems support more than 25% of US data centres.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce cut the ribbon on the 250,000 sq ft, USD 24 million Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, stating genset production capacity more than doubles by end of 2026 and that its backup systems support more than 25% of US data centres.

techCards.title: Baudouin positions 1,900 to 6,250 kVA range for hyperscale campuses and pushes lead time as the decisive variable
techCards.sowhat: This is the sales script Cummins Arabia will meet in Gulf data centre bids: a bigger single unit and a shorter delivery slot. Cummins Arabia needs firm factory slot commitments in its proposals and should quantify Cummins' service network and parts stock in KSA and UAE against Baudouin's thin local footprint.

techCards.title: MHIET 500 kW class 100% hydrogen engine generator set reaches commercial readiness level
techCards.sowhat: Relevant to NEOM and UAE hydrogen showcase projects where zero carbon backup power will be specified. Cummins Arabia should be ready to discuss Cummins hydrogen engine roadmap when consultants raise this.
techCards.summary: 435 kWe at 1,500 rpm from a 6-cylinder 170 mm bore engine on pure hydrogen, tested at Sagamihara with green hydrogen; only long-term durability evaluation remains.

sec.read: 435 kWe at 1,500 rpm from a 6-cylinder 170 mm bore engine on pure hydrogen, tested at Sagamihara with green hydrogen; only long-term durability evaluation remains.

techCards.title: Liebherr expands Colmar engine plant for Rehlko KD Series data centre demand
techCards.sowhat: Engine supply was the constraint on KD Series volume. Doubling it removes a lead time argument Cummins Arabia could previously use in the 2 MW to 4 MW band. Expect more aggressive KD availability quotes into Gulf data centre projects from 2027.
techCards.summary: Ceremony at Liebherr-Components Colmar marked a nearly 12,000 square metre extension; engine production capacity for Rehlko will more than double once fully ramped. Rehlko cited a growing backlog to convert into long-term revenue.

sec.read: Ceremony at Liebherr-Components Colmar marked a nearly 12,000 square metre extension; engine production capacity for Rehlko will more than double once fully ramped. Rehlko cited a growing backlog to convert into long-term revenue.

techCards.title: Generac buys Belvidere, Illinois plant to add large-megawatt genset packaging capacity from Q1 2027, after February 2026 Enercon acquisition
techCards.sowhat: More US packaging capacity shortens Generac lead times for export orders in 2027. Cummins Arabia should expect Generac to quote competitive delivery on Gulf hyperscale sites from 2027.
techCards.summary: The facility adds over 100 jobs and follows the acquisition of Enercon Engineering (enclosures and switchgear) and expansions in Oshkosh, Beaver Dam and Sussex.

sec.read: The facility adds over 100 jobs and follows the acquisition of Enercon Engineering (enclosures and switchgear) and expansions in Oshkosh, Beaver Dam and Sussex.

techCards.title: MHI-ESA headline partner at DCD Connect APAC 2026, pitching MGS-R and grid-to-chip resilience
techCards.sowhat: Mitsubishi is marketing MGS as an AI data centre product in Asia. The same hyperscale and colocation operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should track which APAC operators standardise on MGS and prepare Gulf-specific counters.
techCards.summary: MHI-ESA presented MGS-R innovations and one-stop data centre solutions for AI and HPC workloads in Bali.

sec.read: MHI-ESA presented MGS-R innovations and one-stop data centre solutions for AI and HPC workloads in Bali.

techCards.title: Generac SD3250 (3.25 MW, Baudouin Baudouin M55) wins Consulting-Specifying Engineer 2026 gold award; large diesel series 1.75 to 3.25 MW
techCards.sowhat: The series maps onto Cummins Arabia's C2000 to C3500 data centre band. Note the engine is Baudouin, so the product competes on Generac packaging and Baudouin lead time, not on a proprietary engine.
techCards.summary: The 3.25 MW unit is Generac's largest diesel set, part of a new large diesel series from 1.75 to 3.25 MW built for data centres, healthcare and infrastructure.

sec.read: The 3.25 MW unit is Generac's largest diesel set, part of a new large diesel series from 1.75 to 3.25 MW built for data centres, healthcare and infrastructure.

techCards.title: Rehlko opens Kenosha, Wisconsin assembly for eFRAME enclosures up to 4 MW
techCards.sowhat: Capacity is being added for enclosed 4 MW packages, the format hyperscalers specify. This is North American capacity, so lead time relief for Gulf orders would come from Brest and Changzhou instead. Cummins Arabia should track quoted lead times from Rehlko distributors on 2.5 MW to 4 MW enclosed sets.
techCards.summary: New facility for integrated eFRAME enclosures for backup generator solutions up to 4 MW, with plans to expand capacity by more than 400% through the decade; initial production late 2026, full capacity early 2027.

sec.read: New facility for integrated eFRAME enclosures for backup generator solutions up to 4 MW, with plans to expand capacity by more than 400% through the decade; initial production late 2026, full capacity early 2027.

techCards.title: FG Wilson gensets pass HVO field trials with Tria Energy
techCards.sowhat: HVO acceptance is becoming a standard question in data centre tenders in the UAE. FG Wilson now has published trial evidence to cite. Cummins Arabia should have equivalent HVO approval statements for its data centre range ready in tender documents.
techCards.summary: FG Wilson Engineering (Dublin) Ltd and Tria Energy reported diesel-equivalent performance on HVO (EN 15940) across load conditions with no engine or fuel system changes, up to 90 percent lifecycle CO2 savings, aimed at data centre, construction and critical infrastructure customers.

sec.read: FG Wilson Engineering (Dublin) Ltd and Tria Energy reported diesel-equivalent performance on HVO (EN 15940) across load conditions with no engine or fuel system changes, up to 90 percent lifecycle CO2 savings, aimed at data centre, construction and critical infrastructure customers.

techCards.title: Rehlko introduces next-generation APM804 control platform
techCards.sowhat: Controls and paralleling are a decision factor for data centre consultants. Cummins Arabia should ensure PowerCommand paralleling and monitoring capabilities are presented head to head with APM804 in consultant briefings.
techCards.summary: New controller aimed at the complexity, scale and resilience requirements of modern data centres; APM804 now appears as a standard controller option on KD spec sheets.

sec.read: New controller aimed at the complexity, scale and resilience requirements of modern data centres; APM804 now appears as a standard controller option on KD spec sheets.

techCards.title: Q1 2026: Caterpillar triples large reciprocating engine capacity plan to about 3x 2024 levels, adds about 15 GW per year, power generation +48%
techCards.sowhat: This is the structural threat. By 2028 Cat will have far more 3500, C175 and G3500 engine supply than today and will need non-US outlets for it, and the Gulf is the obvious one. Cummins Arabia should lock multi-year supply agreements and service contracts with key Saudi and UAE accounts in 2026 and 2027 while Cat is still capacity constrained.
techCards.summary: Q1 2026 sales USD 17.4 billion (+22%), Power & Energy USD 7 billion (+22%), power generation sales +48%; large engine capacity plan raised from 2x to nearly 3x 2024 levels with investment mainly 2027 to 2029, about 15 GW of additional annual capacity; large engine backlog up 3.5x since January 2024; tariff cost guidance cut to USD 2.2 to 2.4 billion; six agreements of at least 1 GW each announced; EAME outlook noted softening anticipated in the Middle East.

sec.read: Q1 2026 sales USD 17.4 billion (+22%), Power & Energy USD 7 billion (+22%), power generation sales +48%; large engine capacity plan raised from 2x to nearly 3x 2024 levels with investment mainly 2027 to 2029, about 15 GW of additional annual capacity; large engine backlog up 3.5x since January 2024; tariff cost guidance cut to USD 2.2 to 2.4 billion; six agreements of at least 1 GW each announced; EAME outlook noted softening anticipated in the Middle East.

techCards.title: Volvo Penta publishes data centre backup power positioning: Tier 4 Final platform, modular approach, independent partner to OEMs and system integrators
techCards.sowhat: Volvo's data centre pitch is modular many-small-units, which fits edge and enterprise sites rather than the hyperscale campuses driving Gulf demand. Cummins Arabia should watch packager bids on edge data centres in UAE.
techCards.summary: Volvo Penta states it collaborates with OEMs and system integrators on flexible data centre backup power, cites automotive-scale production for shorter lead times, stackable modular configurations and HVO100 compatibility for all engines built since 2016.

sec.read: Volvo Penta states it collaborates with OEMs and system integrators on flexible data centre backup power, cites automotive-scale production for shorter lead times, stackable modular configurations and HVO100 compatibility for all engines built since 2016.

techCards.title: FG Wilson lists new 'M' variants across the large range (P1100-1M to P2500-3M) with DSE7410 control
techCards.sowhat: FG Wilson's top end remains 2,500 kVA on the mechanical 4016-61TRG3 while the electronic 5016 is sold to other packagers. Cummins Arabia's C2500 to C3500 range and its factory data centre ratings remain a differentiator above 2,500 kVA and in DCC rated applications. Below 2,500 kVA expect the refreshed FG Wilson range to be pushed hard by TAMGO and FG Wilson FZE.
techCards.summary: FG Wilson's large range pages now pair each legacy model with an M variant (P1100-1M, P1650-1M, P2250-3M, P2500-3M), all on Perkins 4008, 4012 and 4016 engines, FG Wilson alternators with AREP excitation and Deep Sea 7410 controllers, with new datasheets dated 2024-10 and 2026-03.

sec.read: FG Wilson's large range pages now pair each legacy model with an M variant (P1100-1M, P1650-1M, P2250-3M, P2500-3M), all on Perkins 4008, 4012 and 4016 engines, FG Wilson alternators with AREP excitation and Deep Sea 7410 controllers, with new datasheets dated 2024-10 and 2026-03.

techCards.title: Perkins shows 2600 Series, hydrogen hybrid IOPU and battery-electric power unit at CONEXPO 2026
techCards.sowhat: Hybrid and alternative fuel work is still at prototype stage for Perkins and is aimed at off-highway more than gensets. The relevant signal is the Stage V 2600 Series, which packagers can pair with Gulf tenders that start asking for Stage V or Tier 4 Final in urban and data centre sites. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Stage V and Tier 4 Final genset offer visible to consultants in UAE and KSA.
techCards.summary: Perkins announced the 904J-E36TTA (129 kW), the 13 litre 2600 Series (340 to 515 kW, Stage V and Tier 4 Final), Project Coeus hydrogen hybrid IOPU (379 kW combined) and a 95.5 kW battery-electric power unit. Richard Hemmings, VP and GM Global Sales, Marketing, Service and Parts, framed the message as lower total cost of ownership and future fuel readiness.

sec.read: Perkins announced the 904J-E36TTA (129 kW), the 13 litre 2600 Series (340 to 515 kW, Stage V and Tier 4 Final), Project Coeus hydrogen hybrid IOPU (379 kW combined) and a 95.5 kW battery-electric power unit. Richard Hemmings, VP and GM Global Sales, Marketing, Service and Parts, framed the message as lower total cost of ownership and future fuel readiness.

techCards.title: Modular mtu gas engine power plants launched in 10, 20 and 30 MW blocks, 12 to 18 months to grid
techCards.sowhat: Modular gas blocks with a 12 to 18 month schedule are aimed at exactly the bridging power tenders that Saudi and UAE data centre developers are issuing while grid connections lag. Cummins Arabia's HSK78G offers competitive efficiency but Cummins has not published a comparable pre-engineered block product; Cummins Arabia should build a reference 10 MW HSK78G block design with local balance of plant partners.
techCards.summary: Preconfigured, factory-tested 20V4000 L64 modules deliver plants from 5 MW to several hundred MW, hydrogen-ready and biomethane capable, for utilities, data centres and industry. Rolls-Royce cites 17 GW plus of installed gas capacity and 500 mtu gas gensets in the UK.

sec.read: Preconfigured, factory-tested 20V4000 L64 modules deliver plants from 5 MW to several hundred MW, hydrogen-ready and biomethane capable, for utilities, data centres and industry. Rolls-Royce cites 17 GW plus of installed gas capacity and 500 mtu gas gensets in the UK.

techCards.title: Volvo Penta introduces G17 natural gas engine for power generation, aimed at data centres and utilities
techCards.sowhat: Adds a gas option at the 17 litre node for packagers. In the Gulf the relevant overlap is with Cummins gas gensets in the 400 to 700 kW band for oil and gas and utility sites in KSA and Kuwait.
techCards.summary: First Volvo Penta natural gas genset engine, framed as lower-emission, scalable backup power for data centres, utilities and mission-critical infrastructure.

sec.read: First Volvo Penta natural gas genset engine, framed as lower-emission, scalable backup power for data centres, utilities and mission-critical infrastructure.

techCards.title: First emergency gensets with verified Environmental Product Declarations: 16V4000 DS2500 and 10V1600
techCards.sowhat: EPDs will be asked for by hyperscalers and by UAE and Saudi green building schemes. If a UAE data centre RFP requires EPDs, Cummins Arabia needs Cummins' equivalent documentation ready or it loses on a compliance line rather than on price.
techCards.summary: Rolls-Royce delivered the first data centre gensets carrying externally verified EPDs published via Environdec to a European operator, positioning EPDs as a new transparency standard for critical power.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce delivered the first data centre gensets carrying externally verified EPDs published via Environdec to a European operator, positioning EPDs as a new transparency standard for critical power.

techCards.title: Rehlko launches all-new KD Series 60 to 600 kW generators
techCards.sowhat: Below 600 kW is outside the large genset band but this unifies Rehlko's catalogue for distributors, which simplifies their selling and service story in the Gulf. Cummins Arabia's C-series coverage in the same band remains broader, and it should hold price discipline rather than react.
techCards.summary: Rehlko extended the KD brand down into the 60 to 600 kW range, presenting it as a global standard in 80 to 600 kW power and consolidating its industrial lineup under one brand.

sec.read: Rehlko extended the KD brand down into the 60 to 600 kW range, presenting it as a global standard in 80 to 600 kW power and consolidating its industrial lineup under one brand.

techCards.title: Volvo Penta positions itself as total power solutions provider for the digital infrastructure market at CONEXPO 2026
techCards.sowhat: KJ Power is a Turkish packager active in Gulf tenders; Volvo BESS subsystems inside packager products would compete with Cummins BESS in rental and hybrid applications.
techCards.summary: Volvo Penta announced it would show D8 Stage V/Tier 4 Final, BESS, electric driveline and its energy transition roadmap, and referenced BESS wins with KJ Power (Turkey), Aura Clean Energy and SEETEL.

sec.read: Volvo Penta announced it would show D8 Stage V/Tier 4 Final, BESS, electric driveline and its energy transition roadmap, and referenced BESS wins with KJ Power (Turkey), Aura Clean Energy and SEETEL.

techCards.title: Baudouin publishes November 2025 data centre genset rating cards (50 and 60 Hz) covering WPG1900 to WPG5775
techCards.sowhat: The 60 Hz card matters for Saudi Arabia: Baudouin now publishes DCR and DCP ratings at 1800 rpm including 13.8 kV medium voltage sets, which is what Saudi data centre specifications ask for. Cummins Arabia should benchmark its 60 Hz C2500 to C3500 DCC offers against the WPG2500B76 to WPG4000B76 band.
techCards.summary: The 50 Hz card runs from WPG1900 (16M33G1900, 1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5775 (20M61G5940, 5,250 kVA DCP at 11 kV); the 60 Hz card runs from WPG1540B76 (1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5000B76 (20M61G5000, 6,250 kVA DCR at 13.8 kV). EPA Tier 2 genset models are available.

sec.read: The 50 Hz card runs from WPG1900 (16M33G1900, 1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5775 (20M61G5940, 5,250 kVA DCP at 11 kV); the 60 Hz card runs from WPG1540B76 (1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5000B76 (20M61G5000, 6,250 kVA DCR at 13.8 kV). EPA Tier 2 genset models are available.

techCards.title: Caterpillar commits USD 725 million to expand Lafayette large engine plant for 3500 series power generation engines
techCards.sowhat: The 3512 and 3516 are the engines behind the gensets Cummins Arabia meets most often in Gulf tenders. More 3500 capacity shortens Cat lead times from 2027, which removes one of the few advantages Cummins has held while Cat allocated engines to US hyperscalers.
techCards.summary: USD 725 million capital expansion at the Lafayette, Indiana large engine centre that builds Cat 3500 engines for power generation and data centre applications, plus a USD 100 million five-year US workforce pledge.

sec.read: USD 725 million capital expansion at the Lafayette, Indiana large engine centre that builds Cat 3500 engines for power generation and data centre applications, plus a USD 100 million five-year US workforce pledge.

techCards.title: MHI-ESA launches containerised MGS2500R for data centres
techCards.sowhat: A plug-in containerised 2.5 MVA set is the format UAE and Kuwait colocation builders ask for. Cummins Arabia should have a matching containerised C2500 or C2750 offer priced and documented for 50 Hz markets before Mitsubishi dealers bring this to Dubai.
techCards.summary: Up to 2,500 kVA standby in a 40 ft high cube container, Critical Power and Data Center Continuous Power duty, Tier III and Tier IV compliant, launched at Data Centre World Asia 2025 in Singapore with an APAC 50 Hz focus.

sec.read: Up to 2,500 kVA standby in a 40 ft high cube container, Critical Power and Data Center Continuous Power duty, Tier III and Tier IV compliant, launched at Data Centre World Asia 2025 in Singapore with an APAC 50 Hz focus.

techCards.title: Fast-start mtu 20V4000 gas gensets for data centre prime and backup power, 45 second start from 2026
techCards.sowhat: This targets the same grid-constrained data centre prime power need that Cummins addresses with the HSK78G and QSK95 gas sets, and the 60 Hz variant is built for markets like Saudi Arabia. In UAE and KSA data centre campuses where gas is available, mtu can now bid diesel backup, gas prime and dynamic UPS as one package. Cummins Arabia should lead with HSK78G efficiency and Cummins' Gulf gas service record before mtu's 60 Hz set ships.
techCards.summary: Rolls-Royce launched a 2.8 MW 20V4000 L64 gas genset with 10% better efficiency, 120 second start today and a 45 second start 60 Hz model from 2026, aimed at data centres waiting for grid connections. Existing gas genset fleets cited in the UK (500 plus), Canada and Jakarta.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce launched a 2.8 MW 20V4000 L64 gas genset with 10% better efficiency, 120 second start today and a 45 second start 60 Hz model from 2026, aimed at data centres waiting for grid connections. Existing gas genset fleets cited in the UK (500 plus), Canada and Jakarta.

techCards.title: Caterpillar launches Cat D1500 1.5 MW compact diesel genset on C32B engine
techCards.sowhat: A 1.5 MW node on a 32 litre engine attacks the footprint and weight argument in the 1,500 to 1,875 kVA class where Cummins sells QSK50 based sets in Saudi 60 Hz projects. Watch for a 50 Hz and Middle East release; until then it is a North America product.
techCards.summary: New D1500 60 Hz standby genset on the 32.1 litre C32B, up to 13% less floor space and 32% lighter than the previous 1.5 MW node, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency, targeted at North America first.

sec.read: New D1500 60 Hz standby genset on the 32.1 litre C32B, up to 13% less floor space and 32% lighter than the previous 1.5 MW node, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency, targeted at North America first.

techCards.title: MTU Yuchai Power JV in Suzhou adds Series 2000 G06 and Series 4000 S83 production, 3,000 engines built to date
techCards.sowhat: Chinese built mtu engines create a lower cost route for Chinese genset packagers exporting to the Gulf. Cummins Arabia already competes with Chinese packaged Cummins engines from Cummins' own China plants; mtu now has a comparable lever. Watch for Suzhou sourced mtu gensets appearing in UAE and KSA rental and construction tenders.
techCards.summary: Rolls-Royce's Chinese JV with Guangxi Yuchai, established 2014, expanded its scope in 2024 and now builds Series 2000 and 4000 variants for data centres, rental, industrial parks and oil and gas, including for overseas projects in neighbouring regions.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce's Chinese JV with Guangxi Yuchai, established 2014, expanded its scope in 2024 and now builds Series 2000 and 4000 variants for data centres, rental, industrial parks and oil and gas, including for overseas projects in neighbouring regions.

techCards.title: USD 75 million Aiken, South Carolina expansion to machine Series 4000 engines in the US from July 2027
techCards.sowhat: A second Series 4000 engine source reduces mtu's single-plant dependency on Friedrichshafen, which has historically capped what its Gulf distributors could deliver in a given year. Monitor mtu lead-time quotes in KSA and UAE from 2027.
techCards.summary: Phase 1 adds 37,000 sq ft (potential 60,000 sq ft) to the Aiken engine plant so Series 4000 components are machined in-country instead of shipped finished from Germany. Construction starts Q1 2026, production July 2027, 60 new jobs on a 434 person site.

sec.read: Phase 1 adds 37,000 sq ft (potential 60,000 sq ft) to the Aiken engine plant so Series 4000 components are machined in-country instead of shipped finished from Germany. Construction starts Q1 2026, production July 2027, 60 new jobs on a 434 person site.

techCards.title: MHIET launches 450 kW gas cogeneration system capable of hydrogen co-firing
techCards.sowhat: Small gas CHP is a Japan-first product. Gulf relevance is limited today but it signals Mitsubishi will pitch hydrogen-ready gas engines into Saudi and UAE decarbonisation programmes where Cummins gas gensets also compete.
techCards.summary: Reliability verified through demonstration testing; part of MHIET's low carbon gas engine roadmap.

sec.read: Reliability verified through demonstration testing; part of MHIET's low carbon gas engine roadmap.

techCards.title: USD 24 million Mankato expansion to lift Series 4000 genset output by more than 120% by 2026
techCards.sowhat: Mankato builds 60 Hz sets, the frequency Saudi Arabia runs on. More 60 Hz Series 4000 capacity shortens the lead times mtu can quote into Saudi data centre and industrial tenders from 2026. Cummins Arabia's 60 Hz lead-time advantage in KSA narrows as this ramps.
techCards.summary: Rolls-Royce announced a new Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, Minnesota to raise Series 4000 generator set production more than 120% by 2026 versus the prior year, adding over 100 jobs. Data centre sales grew almost 50% in 2024; Stratmann said hyperscale customers have relied on mtu for over 15 years.

sec.read: Rolls-Royce announced a new Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, Minnesota to raise Series 4000 generator set production more than 120% by 2026 versus the prior year, adding over 100 jobs. Data centre sales grew almost 50% in 2024; Stratmann said hyperscale customers have relied on mtu for over 15 years.

techCards.title: Baudouin platinum sponsor at Middle East Energy 2025: 20M61 genset (6,250 kVA) pre-launch, 6M31 Stage V PowerKit, 20M55 gas genset
techCards.sowhat: A 6,250 kVA single unit outranks Cummins' largest diesel node and is aimed at hyperscale campuses in the UAE and KSA. Cummins Arabia's counter is the installed base, Cummins factory paralleling and controls, service depth and proven 50 degree C performance. It should also test Baudouin's lead-time claims against real Cummins slot availability when quoting.
techCards.summary: At Dubai World Trade Centre (stand S3.B40 and outdoor OS.90), Baudouin revealed the 20M61 data centre genset up to 6,250 kVA, launched the 6M31 Stage V-ready PowerKit and showed a 20M55 gas genset up to 5,250 kVA, 12M33 plus SCR Stage V and 6M16 Stage V. CEO Fabrizio Mozzi called it the largest genset available for critical backup power. Baudouin claimed best lead times in the market.

sec.read: At Dubai World Trade Centre (stand S3.B40 and outdoor OS.90), Baudouin revealed the 20M61 data centre genset up to 6,250 kVA, launched the 6M31 Stage V-ready PowerKit and showed a 20M55 gas genset up to 5,250 kVA, 12M33 plus SCR Stage V and 6M16 Stage V. CEO Fabrizio Mozzi called it the largest genset available for critical backup power. Baudouin claimed best lead times in the market.

techCards.title: Perkins brings new 2606 (13 L) and 5012 (46 L) engines to Middle East Energy 2025 in Dubai
techCards.sowhat: The 5012 sits exactly on the 1,250 to 1,875 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSK50 and QSK60 based sets into data centres and hospitals, and it is offered to every independent packager in the Gulf. The 2606 attacks the 350 to 550 kVA band with 1,000 hour service intervals. Cummins Arabia should benchmark total cost of ownership against 5012-powered Jubaili and Teksan sets and lead with factory-packaged reliability, local service coverage and 50 degree C ambient performance.
techCards.summary: Perkins showcased the 2606 (350 to 550 kVA at 50 Hz, available H2 2025, 1,000 hour service intervals, HVO and B100 capable) and the electronic 5012 (1,275 to 1,875 kVA at 50 Hz, 1,125 to 1,500 kWe at 60 Hz, ISO G3, NFPA110, EPA Tier 2 on 60 Hz). Applications cited: data centres, hospitals, power plants.

sec.read: Perkins showcased the 2606 (350 to 550 kVA at 50 Hz, available H2 2025, 1,000 hour service intervals, HVO and B100 capable) and the electronic 5012 (1,275 to 1,875 kVA at 50 Hz, 1,125 to 1,500 kWe at 60 Hz, ISO G3, NFPA110, EPA Tier 2 on 60 Hz). Applications cited: data centres, hospitals, power plants.

techCards.title: MHI-ESA adds MGS assembly plant in Johor Bahru, Malaysia with WDG Assembly
techCards.sowhat: Extra MGS capacity in Asia shortens lead times for Gulf orders that ship from Singapore. Cummins Arabia should expect Mitsubishi dealers in KSA and UAE to quote firmer delivery on 1.5 MVA to 2.75 MVA sets.
techCards.summary: New production hub for MGS units to meet rising data centre and critical infrastructure demand in Southeast Asia, alongside Singapore and Vietnam assembly.

sec.read: New production hub for MGS units to meet rising data centre and critical infrastructure demand in Southeast Asia, alongside Singapore and Vietnam assembly.

techCards.title: Upgraded mtu Series 1600 gensets launched for 50 Hz market, 590 to 996 kVA
techCards.sowhat: This pushes mtu down into the 600 to 1,000 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in volume for UAE and Kuwait 50 Hz projects. mtu's argument is data centre grade load factors and HVO approval on a compact 22 litre engine. Cummins Arabia should hold the position on price, lead time and local stock, which mtu's distributors cannot match in this band.
techCards.summary: New 12V1600 Gx1 based gensets deliver up to 40% more power than the predecessor, are approved for HVO (EN 15940), meet ISO 8528-5 class G3 and carry 100% load factor ratings for data centre use. Aimed at data centres, healthcare, commercial buildings and edge sites; the 60 Hz version launched in late 2023.

sec.read: New 12V1600 Gx1 based gensets deliver up to 40% more power than the predecessor, are approved for HVO (EN 15940), meet ISO 8528-5 class G3 and carry 100% load factor ratings for data centre use. Aimed at data centres, healthcare, commercial buildings and edge sites; the 60 Hz version launched in late 2023.

techCards.title: Baudouin launches complete generator sets for data centres, 2,000 to 5,250 kVA (baseline)
techCards.sowhat: This is the structural change: Baudouin now bids as a single-brand genset supplier, not just an engine to local packagers, and it targets the same hyperscale and colocation buyers Cummins Arabia courts in Riyadh, Dammam, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Cummins Arabia should expect Baudouin gensets in consultant shortlists from 2025 onward.
techCards.summary: Baudouin moved from engines only to complete M33 and M55 gensets for data centres with Uptime Institute pre-approved units and announced the 20M55 genset (4,250 to 5,250 kVA). Manufacturing sites listed in India, China, Russia, Italy, Germany, France and the US.

sec.read: Baudouin moved from engines only to complete M33 and M55 gensets for data centres with Uptime Institute pre-approved units and announced the 20M55 genset (4,250 to 5,250 kVA). Manufacturing sites listed in India, China, Russia, Italy, Germany, France and the US.

techCards.title: MHIET launches MGS3100R, a 3,000 kVA class set with common rail S16R2 engine
techCards.sowhat: This is Mitsubishi's answer to the 2.5 MW to 3 MW data centre node that Cummins serves with QSK78 and QSK95 based sets. It is not yet on the Middle East catalogue, which caps Mitsubishi's Gulf offer at 2,750 kVA until MHIES-ME adopts MGS-R. Cummins Arabia should keep quoting above 2.75 MVA where Mitsubishi cannot follow locally.
techCards.summary: MGS3100R rated 3,025 kVA standby / critical power and 2,750 kVA prime / data centre continuous at 50 Hz, 6,785 x 2,820 x 3,170 mm, 23,100 kg dry, ISO 8528-5 G3 and NFPA 110, assembled in Singapore and Vietnam for factories, hospitals and data centres in Asia Pacific. MHIET stated MGS had sold over 12,000 units to date.

sec.read: MGS3100R rated 3,025 kVA standby / critical power and 2,750 kVA prime / data centre continuous at 50 Hz, 6,785 x 2,820 x 3,170 mm, 23,100 kg dry, ISO 8528-5 G3 and NFPA 110, assembled in Singapore and Vietnam for factories, hospitals and data centres in Asia Pacific. MHIET stated MGS had sold over 12,000 units to date.

techCards.title: Volvo Penta launches D17, its most powerful genset engine (TWD1744GE, 758 kVA prime at 50 Hz) (baseline)
techCards.sowhat: Lifts Volvo's ceiling to about 880 kVA standby at 60 Hz, which puts Volvo-powered packager sets against Cummins QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in Saudi commercial and industrial standby. Above that band Volvo has no offer.
techCards.summary: 17.26 litre six cylinder with dual-stage turbochargers and common rail, EPA Tier 2 certified for stationary emergency, dual speed 1500/1800 rpm, service interval up to 1,000 hours; 50 Hz prime 758 kVA, standby 833 kVA; 60 Hz prime 801 kVA, standby 881 kVA.

sec.read: 17.26 litre six cylinder with dual-stage turbochargers and common rail, EPA Tier 2 certified for stationary emergency, dual speed 1500/1800 rpm, service interval up to 1,000 hours; 50 Hz prime 758 kVA, standby 833 kVA; 60 Hz prime 801 kVA, standby 881 kVA.

techCards.title: Volvo Penta adds D13 power node TAD1346GE 500 kVA
techCards.sowhat: 500 kVA is the most contested packager node in the Gulf commercial market; a D13 at 500 kVA competes with Cummins QSX15 based sets on price through packagers.
techCards.summary: New D13 rating described as reliable, compact and fuel-efficient addition to the power offer.

sec.read: New D13 rating described as reliable, compact and fuel-efficient addition to the power offer.

rehlko-m12.title: Rehlko launches programme to double Changzhou backup power capacity from 5.5 GW to 11 GW

KSSL_PARTNERS.label: The Olayan Group (Olayan Financing Company)
KSSL_PARTNERS.note: 50:50 three-country distribution joint venture. Olayan has distributed Cummins products in Saudi Arabia since 1956; the JV consolidated Cummins' wholly owned UAE distributor, General Contracting Company (KSA) and General Transportation and Equipment (Kuwait). Announced 2016-03-29, launched May 2017.
KSSL_PARTNERS.insight: Olayan's Saudi standing and 70 years of Cummins distribution history give Cummins Arabia access and localisation credentials that imported-brand dealers cannot match in KSA government and Aramco-linked procurement.
KSSL_PARTNERS.mean: Opportunity: Olayan's Saudi standing and 70 years of Cummins distribution history give Cummins Arabia access and localisation credentials that imported-brand dealers cannot match in KSA government and Aramco-linked procurement.

KSSL_PARTNERS.label: Cummins Inc. (Cummins Power Generation, Cummins Middle East)
KSSL_PARTNERS.note: Cummins Inc. is the 50 percent JV partner and sole OEM supplier; Cummins Middle East co-hosted the 2025 UAE BESS launch and the New Energy Solutions EMEIA team supported the Dubai BESS commissioning.
KSSL_PARTNERS.insight: Direct factory alignment (Power Systems, New Energy Solutions) gives Cummins Arabia first access to new products such as Centum and BESS, but also means Gulf allocation depends on Cummins Inc's global prioritisation.
KSSL_PARTNERS.mean: Opportunity: Direct factory alignment (Power Systems, New Energy Solutions) gives Cummins Arabia first access to new products such as Centum and BESS, but also means Gulf allocation depends on Cummins Inc's global prioritisation.

KSSL_PARTNERS.label: OWS Automotive Solutions LLC
KSSL_PARTNERS.note: MoU to develop powertrain solutions and technical support for defence applications in the Middle East (fleet analysis, feasibility studies, post-installation services), signed in Dubai after IDEX 2023; Ian Norton, Operations Director, Cummins Arabia, quoted.
KSSL_PARTNERS.insight: Defence powertrain support is adjacent to the genset business but opens military end-user relationships in the UAE that can carry tactical and base power generation opportunities.
KSSL_PARTNERS.mean: Watch: Defence powertrain support is adjacent to the genset business but opens military end-user relationships in the UAE that can carry tactical and base power generation opportunities.

KSSL_PARTNERS.label: Regional technology provider (hyperscale data centre operator, unnamed)
KSSL_PARTNERS.note: 36 gensets (30 DQLC, 6 DQCA) totalling 73.2 MW across multiple hyperscale sites in Saudi Arabia, delivered in seven months with FAT per model and Uptime Institute compliant balance of plant.
KSSL_PARTNERS.insight: The customer recommended Cummins Arabia for future projects per the case study; this account is the anchor for repeat 60 Hz QSK78 volume in KSA and a reference for other operators.
KSSL_PARTNERS.mean: Opportunity: The customer recommended Cummins Arabia for future projects per the case study; this account is the anchor for repeat 60 Hz QSK78 volume in KSA and a reference for other operators.

KSSL_PARTNERS.label: Major network and communication service provider (unnamed telecom), Riyadh
KSSL_PARTNERS.note: Controls modernisation of three 800 kW QSK23-G3 gensets (MC-150 to DMC6000, PCC3200 to PCC3300) with long-term spare parts support.
KSSL_PARTNERS.insight: Demonstrates lifecycle service revenue from a 20 year old installed base; template for Saudi telecom and utility retrofit programmes.
